Ash Dragon.intro_text: The Japanese Wiki suggests that the name and title from this NM are likely a parody of a Japanese band. One could therefore assume that it is a reference to the Japanese rap rock band founded in 1996 named Dragon Ash.

Aspidochelone.intro_text: An Aspidochelone in Medieval folklore was a giant "Asp-turtle" that was so huge that some mistake it for a small island. It was said to have trees and plants growing on its back to add to the illusion it was an island. Some of the legends say it would only surface for a short period of time, and then submerge, sometimes killing those who sought shelter on the beast. The stories about Sindbad's voyages have a small article about an encounter with a beast that looked like an island but swam beneath the waves. The breakdown of the name roughly translates into "Shield Turtle."

Atkorkamuy.intro_text: * In Ainu folklore, Atkorkamuy is a gigantic octopus god which resides in Hokkaido’s Uchiura Bay. The name means "string holding God," referring to its tentacles. When it extends its legs, it can stretch out over one hectare in area. It is said to be large enough that it can swallow boats and even whales in a single gulp. Its entire body is red and it is so massive that it turns the sky and sea deep red when it appears. Therefore, locals avoid the water when the sea or sky turns red.

Rugaroo.intro_text: The Rougarou is a mythical werewolf-like shapeshifter, found in the legends of various French-speaking peoples. Per Wikipedia, "The rougarou most often is described as a creature with a human body and the head of a wolf or dog," which is probably why this monster is a Gnole.

Schah.intro_text: Shah or "Schah" is the Persian (Iranian) word for King, Asvha is Sanskrit (Indian) for horse, Gaja is Sanskrit for elephant, Ratha is Sanskrit for chariot, Mantri is Sanskrit for minister or sage, and Bhata is Sanskrit for infantry, soldier, servant, slave, etc. This NM is based off of the 6th century (CE) Indian strategy game of Chaturanga or modern day chess. The king, minister, chariots, elephants, horses, and infantry were set up according to battle formations described in ancient literature and poetry. In the game though while the rest of the pieces are the same, Schah is not one of them.

Scylla.intro_text: * Added in the November 9th, 2009 Version Update. * In Greek mythology, Scylla was a created that lived on the opposite side of a narrow channel of water from Charybdis. Sailors would have to make the choice to pass closer to either, picking the lesser of two evils.

Teles.intro_text: Teles is one of the various Siren Sisters in Greek mythology. No one can seem to agree on the number of them or names. Homer didn't even give them names in fact. However, Sirens seek to who lure unsuspecting victims with their enchanting music and voices and shipwreck on the rocky coast of their island. Comparatively in FFXI Sirens are dangerous creatures which wish to "entice" and charm you. Causing you to assist in the murder all your companions in the hopes of keeping you from obtaining an Aeonic Weapon.

Wasserspeier.intro_text: This being in reference to the architectural functionality of a gargoyle. Which was designed to guide water from a roof and away from the building. It also made for a good Saturday morning cartoon.

Zerde.intro_text: Zerde is an Iraqi dessert. It is a sweet pudding from rice that is colored yellow with saffron and popularly served at weddings, birthdays, and other occasions. Eating too many sweets is considered unhealthy though, but not as unhealthy for you as Zerde is. The only thing it will be forcing down your throat is sweet death as its bio aura (heart disease?) and custardy goons will put you into a sweet induced coma.

** Floor 4 north and south each have two one-arm non-NM Acroliths.
*** When they are defeated, a third two-arm Acrolith ([[Notorious Monster]]) will spawn.
* [[Bhaflau Remnants II]]: Floor 4
** Floor 4 has two non-NM Acroliths present on both the east and west sides. Regardless of the side, defeating both Acrolith will spawn the Acrolith NM in the room which contained the second Acrolith. Design plans dropped differ depending on the side.
* [[Silver Sea Remnants II]]: Floor 4
** Acroliths are spawned from each of the final 5 [[Archaic Rampart]]s present. An Acrolith will only spawn from a rampart if it is linked with another rampart. If it is aggroed or an offensive action is performed first, a substitute monster will be spawned.
* [[Zhayolm Remnants II]]: Floor 6
** Four Acroliths are normally present in pairs in each of the two side rooms (northwest and southeast) off the main large area.}}

|Notes=
* Found past Diaphanous Gadget #H in [[Sortie]]. Need a [[Ra'Kaznar Shard #H]] to access.
* Changes element based on TP move used. 
** {{Color|fire|Flaming Kick}} {{Fire}} : counter with {{water}} {{color|water|water}} damage.
** {{Color|water|Flashflood}} {{Water}} : counter with {{thunder}} {{color|thunder|thunder}} damage.
** {{Color|ice|Icy Grasp}} {{Ice}} : counter with {{fire}} {{color|fire|fire}} damage.
** {{Color|earth|Eroding Flesh}} {{Earth}} : counter with {{wind}} {{color|wind|wind}} damage.
** {{Color|thunder|Fulminous Smash}} {{Thunder}} : counter with {{earth}} {{color|earth|earth}} damage.
*Upon use of an elemental TP move after the first, will summon fetter(s) which deal damage and apply a respective damage over time debuff dependent on the element type. The number of fetter(s) spawned will increase as Aita's HP decreases. 
*Countering with any appropriate magic damage will proc [[File:Blue.png|link=]].
**Even casting Elemental Magic from a subjob will do the job, and the magic does not have to do more than 0 points of damage.
* {{PAGENAME}} Gains -5% Damage Taken for each 30 seconds of time it remains unprocced after using a TP move. {{verification}}
**E.g. Flaming Kick is used and it will gain -5% DT for every 30 seconds that pass if not procced with a water spell or skillchain before changing elements. It will then retain the -% DT .
**The proc does not reset any existing DT accumulated, and only prevents further build.
*'''Vivisection''' {{magical}} {{dark}} will be used every '''3 minutes''' from the start of battle again once every 3 minutes. Generally KOing all in range, (~20'+?).
**Unlike ''Setting the Stage'', Vivisection may be stopped by [[Elemental Sforzo]] and [[Liement]] but will still fully dispel.
***[[Perfect Defense]] and [[Mana Wall]] are also effective.
***[[Annuls Damage]] proc's while a chance occurrence can completely mitigate the damage as well.
***[[Valiance]] and other effects that reduce magic damage taken will reduce the damage taken by Vivisection.
****It may be reduced enough to survive with Scherzo/Migawari/Earthen Armor, but testing is needed. {{verification}}
**Correctly hitting {{Blue!}} proc will reduce the damage of Vivisection. If the damage is brought below a certain threshold, his wings will disappear.
***This also reduces the rate at which the seal decays
**In the event of a full wipe and recovery the timer does not stop. After three minutes have passed idle, the first move used by {{PAGENAME}} will be Vivisection.
**'''Vivisection''' must hit a target before the timer resets. You may not bind and run away while the timer passes.
*'''Vivisection''' can also be triggered by healing {{PAGENAME}} with the corresponding Elemental Magic or Skillchain damage to the last TP move used.
'''Vivisection''' will reset the elemental weakness of {{PAGENAME}}. A new TP move will need to be used before it becomes vulnerable to elemental damage again.
*In the event of a full wipe, the DT accumulated will not be reset unless you leave the battle area wait a while then re enter.
*{{PAGENAME}} has a resistance ranking of 5% for any element that isn't corresponding to it's last TP move (Light, Dark, etc), a ranking of 150% for the corresponding element (Fire after Flaming Kick, etc), and 70% rank to it's current elemental weakness.
}}

* A 3000 TP [[Savage Blade]] with [[Naegling]] (or other powerful WS) and ilevel gear will kill in 1 hit.

** Can cast [[Meteor]] and [[Drain]] (AOE - 10~15 yard range) below 50% HP.

*Insane StoreTP, ~300+?

{{Adversary Description
|Image=Omega
|Class=NM
|Type=Unclassified
|Family=Biotechnological Weapon
|Main.Job=
|Sub.Job=
|Crystal=
|Detects=
|Notes= 
*Has approximately 100,000 HP
*Immune to [[Stun]] but susceptible to other debuffs including [[Slow]] and [[Elegy]].
*Has 100% [[Double Attack]] rate and uses two TP moves in a row whenever one is used.
*Has two forms:
**Four-legged form (100% to 75% HP)
***Highly resistant to physical damage.
***'''Guided Missile''' - Physical damage AoE.  Absorbed by shadows.
***'''Ion Efflux''' - Conical paralyze.
***'''Target Analysis''' - Absorbs all stats.  Absorbed by shadows.
***'''Pile Pitch''' - Does 90% of targets health in physical damage and resets hate on target.
***'''Rear Lasers''' - Magical AoE damage and petrification.  Only used when hate pulled from behind.
**Two-legged form (< 75% HP)
***Highly resistant to magical damage.
***'''Guided Missile II''' - Physical damage AoE. Ignores shadows.
***'''Hyper Pulse''' - Magic damage AoE and gravity. Wipes shadows.
***'''Stun Cannon''' - Magic damage AoE and paralyze. Ignores shadows.
***'''Floodlight''' - Magic damage large AoE and [[Flash]], [[Bind]] and [[Silence]].
***'''Colossal Blow''' - Does 90% of targets health in physical damage and resets hate on target as well as knock-back.
***'''Laser Shower''' - Conical magic damage. 
***'''Pod Ejection''' - Spawns a [[Gunpod]]. Used periodically in two-legged form regardless of TP.
****[[Gunpod]]s have about 5,000 HP.
****Gunpods must be defeated within ~10 seconds or they will use '''Electrocharge''' to self-destruct and deal severe AoE damage (if they are being kited, this move can be outranged).
****Unlike those from [[Proto-Omega]], these Gunpods have no drops.
}}

wikitext.Arch-Ultima:
{{Adversary Description
|Image=
|Class=NM
|Type=Unclassified
|Family=Biotechnological Weapon
|Main.Job=
|Sub.Job=
|Crystal=Light
|Detects=
|Notes=
*Has approximately 100,000 HP
*Immune to [[Stun]] but susceptible to other debuffs including [[Slow]] and [[Elegy]].
*Uses draw-in on current hate target at certain intervals if too far out of range.
*Uses the following TP moves:
**'''Antimatter''': Single-target Light magic damage. Ignores Utsusemi.
**'''Energy Screen''': Temporary physical damage immunity (cannot be up at the same time as Mana Screen).
**'''Mana Screen''': Temporary magical damage immunity (cannot be up at the same time as Energy Screen).
**'''Catastrophic Malfunction''': AoE damage and reduces elemental resistances.
*** >50% HP: Followed with a tier V nuke or [[Comet]].
*** <50% HP: Followed with a -ja nuke, Banishga IV, or [[Meteor]].
**'''Armor Buster''': Physical AoE damage and gravity. Can be absorbed by shadows. 
**'''Chemical Bomb''': Conical AoE physical damage, [[Slow]], and [[Elegy]].
**'''Equalizer''': Physical AoE damage and knockback.
**'''Wire Cutter''': High single target physical damage attack. Can be absorbed by shadows/third eye.
**'''Hydro Cannon''': Conical water damage and poison. 
**'''Turbofan''': Conical wind damage and silence.
**'''Smoke Discharge''': Conical earth damage and petrification.
**'''Flame Thrower''': Conical fire damage and plague.
**'''Cryojet''': Conical ice damage and paralysis.
**'''High-Tension Discharge''': Conical thunder damage and stun.
**'''Dissipation''': High AoE damage, terror (up to 10 seconds), full dispel (except [[reraise]], food effects, and [[Embrava]])
**At 49%, 39%, 29%, 19%, 9% HP: '''Citadel Siege''': Single target instant KO.
*** Citadel Siege can be avoided if the target is at sufficient distance from Arch-Ultima (start running at 50%, then drop him to 49%, etc.; maintain some proximity to avoid being drawn in). Citadel Siege will be skipped if Arch-Ultima is in the process of readying Citadel Buster.
**<50% HP '''Citadel Buster''': 30' AoE severe light elemental damage
*** Citadel Buster is preceded by a warning countdown starting at 30 seconds ("30...") and continuing to warn players at various intervals. Current hate target will continue to be drawn in during this time, but other actions will cease.}}

==Background==
An Aspidochelone in Medieval folklore was a giant "Asp-turtle" that was so huge that some mistake it for a small island. It was said to have trees and plants growing on its back to add to the illusion it was an island. Some of the legends say it would only surface for a short period of time, and then submerge, sometimes killing those who sought shelter on the beast. The stories about Sindbad's voyages have a small article about an encounter with a beast that looked like an island but swam beneath the waves. The breakdown of the name roughly translates into "Shield Turtle."

==Lore==
* In Ainu folklore, Atkorkamuy is a gigantic octopus god which resides in Hokkaido’s Uchiura Bay. The name means "string holding God," referring to its tentacles. When it extends its legs, it can stretch out over one hectare in area. It is said to be large enough that it can swallow boats and even whales in a single gulp. Its entire body is red and it is so massive that it turns the sky and sea deep red when it appears. Therefore, locals avoid the water when the sea or sky turns red.

|Notes=*The fight involves four Fomor enemies: Borealis Shadow [North] (WAR), Orientalis Shadow [East] (RNG), Occidentalis Shadow [West] (MNK), Australis Shadow [South] (RDM).
*The WAR, RNG, and MNK shadows seem to have innate Regain and will all use Fomor TP abilities.
*The WAR shadow can use axe weaponskills. Rampage can easily one-shot any unbuffed melee. Mistral Axe may be used if the WAR is bound and/or weighted.
*The RNG shadow can use sidewinder which can one-shot tanks.
*The MNK shadow has a very high counter rate and uses Hand-to-Hand weaponskills up to Dragon Kick.
*Due to lethal nature of the weaponskills, it is highly advised to use NIN as a subjob. Failure to keep shadows up will most likely result in death.
*All four of the shadows will weaponskill more frequently when one of them dies. It is highly recommended that they all be lowered to within kill range and then removed simultaneously to avoid this.
*All four shadows are susceptible to most enfeebling magic. While silence and dark-based sleep can land, it is advised to use break instead for crowd control.
*Light skillchains or high damage weaponskills appear to proc {{Blue!}}.
*RDM with Very good Enspell damage can perpetually {{Blue!}} Stun each shadow using Enfire. 
*[[Cipher: Ark TT|Ark Angel Taru]] Can easily sleep these, and his AI will make him always sleepga these monsters making the fight trivial.
}}

{{Adversary Description
|Image=

|Family=Botulus
|Main.Job=
|Sub.Job=
|Crystal=
|Detects=
|Notes= 
* Spawned as part of the quest [[VW Op. 118: Buburimu Squall]]
* Uses several different types of normal melee attacks:
** Frontal: Single target damage, max HP down (~20%)
** Frontal: AoE damage (double), [[Amnesia]]
** Side: AoE damage (triple), knockback
** Rear: AoE damage (quadruple), [[Stun]]
* Has a high [[physical damage taken]] reduction but takes normal magic damage.
* Has a constant [[Bio]] aura (20hp/tic).
* Has [[Auto Regen]].
* Casts all -ja spells and [[Meteor]].
** Has a fairly high [[Fast Cast]] trait.
** Can use [[Chainspell]] multiple times throughout the battle, first used at 65-80% HP. 
*** The next usage takes place several minutes after the first one, and will not occur if defeated quickly enough. [[Fool's Drink]] should be used to survive Chainspell (the extremely large AoE on Meteor makes it nearly impossible to survive through Chainspell without using Fool's Drink or staggering Botulus Rex).
*** Will not use any TP moves or normal melee attacks while [[Chainspell]] is active.
* Uses the following TP moves.  One or more may have hate reset.
** '''Chymous Reek''' Area of Effect damage, additional effect [[Stun]] and [[Choke]] (Choke cannot be removed)
** '''Sloughy Sputum''' Conal damage, knockback, [[Gravity]], and [[Drown]]
** '''Crowning Flatus''' Area of Effect damage, knockback, and [[Stun]]
** '''Rancid Reflux''' Conal damage, knockback, [[Max HP Down]], [[Gravity]]
** '''Just Desserts''' Area of Effect damage, [[Stun]], and [[Drown]] (up to 57 HP/tick)
** '''Gnash 'n Guttle''' Area of Effect [[Max HP Down]]
** <30% HP: '''Slimy Proposal''' Area of Effect [[Charm]] (~30 seconds) and [[Dia]] (over 30 HP/tick), clears negative status ailments on Botulus Rex.
* Botulus Rex has 137 INT, 89 MND, +12.5% [[Magic Damage Taken]], and 40 [[Magic Defense Bonus]]
* As of the February 2012 version update, timing [[Voidwatch Weaknesses|weakness triggers]] properly with TP moves or spells now correctly yields increased alignment/weakness duration on this monster.

|Notes=
*Changes modes between curled and uncurled roughly every 2~3 minutes.
'''Curled''':
*Ceases attacking.
*Receives ~-60% damage taken for the duration of the curl.
*Gains an undispellable {{color|fire|Blaze Spikes}} of roughly 95~110 damage unresisted.
*Will immediately begin using '''Amber Scutum''' repeatedly regardless of TP.
**Brass Borer will do Scutum either 3 or 6 times. Alternating the count in a constant pattern.
**Will proceed to then use '''Cannonball''' repeatedly. For the same number of times as it performed a Scutum.
***Scutum can be dispelled, but Cannonball will still deal massive damage. Upwards of 1,000-1,500 to level 75 players and reaching over 3,000 to Eruca's charmed nearby.
****Cannonball can be absorbed with shadows.
***Cannonball has a very short activation time, but will only be utilized if the target is within 10'.
***If you manage to run out of range while kiting and receive the too far away message, it will still continue performing Cannonball until the number has been reached.
***Amber Scutum and Cannonball consume no TP from Brass Borer.
*Brass Borer will uncurl once the Cannonball attack pattern is complete. If it has TP it will then use it.
'''Uncurled''':
*Possesses double attack.
*Gains an undispellable {{color|fire|Enfire}} of roughly 70~75 damage.
*Has access to the following TP moves:
**'''Heat Barrier''': {{buff}} Dispelable Enfire and Blaze Spikes effect, both dealing roughly 73~78 damage. 	
**'''Thermal Pulse''': AoE {{magical}} {{fire}} ~600+ damage and blind.
**'''Vitriolic Spray''': Conal {{breath}} {{fire}} ~300-500+ damage and 10/tick burn.
**'''Vitriolic Shower''': AoE {{magical}} {{fire}} ~500+ damage and {{Information Needed}}/tick burn.
----
*Has the typical speed of a Wamouracampa, meaning it can be outrun without movement speed equipment.
**Does not lose aggro after running far away. Likely tracks by scent for this reason. {{Information Needed}}
*Nearby Wamoura can link with Brass Borer.
*Susceptible to Blind, Bind, Gravity, Paralyze, Poison, Stun, and Slow.
*Immune to Break and Sleep.
}}

* Defeating Briareus completes the zone quest, [[A Goldstruck Gigas]].
* [[:Category:Gigas#Common TP Moves|Lightning Roar]] grants a strong [[Shock Spikes]] effect.
** Recommended to [[stun]] this if possible.
* [[:Category:Gigas#Common TP Moves|Catapult]] bypasses shadows and [[Dispel]]s one effect.
* Can use [[:Category:Gigas#Common TP Moves|Trebuchet]], [[:Category:Gigas#Common TP Moves|Power Attack]], [[:Category:Gigas#Common TP Moves|Impact Roar]], and [[:Category:Gigas#Common TP Moves|Grand Slam]].
* Also has access to [[:Category:Gigas#Common TP Moves|Colossal Slam]], which does heavy AoE damage (wipes shadows) and inflicts Zombie status for a short time.
** If you are worried about dying, it is safest to kite until this status wears off.
* [[:Category:Gigas#Common TP Moves|Mercurial Strike]] does an amount of damage between 111 and 1111. The particular amount of damage it does determines what will happen next, similar to a [[Corsair]] roll:
** 111 : [[:Category:Gigas#Common TP Moves|Impact Roar]]
** 222 : [[:Category:Gigas#Common TP Moves|Grand Slam]]
** 333 : [[:Category:Gigas#Common TP Moves|Grand Slam]]
** 444 : [[:Category:Gigas#Common TP Moves|Power Attack]]
** 555 : [[:Category:Gigas#Common TP Moves|Trebuchet]] (Absorbed by shadows)
** 666 : [[:Category:Gigas#Common TP Moves|Trebuchet]]
** 777 : [[:Category:Gigas#Common TP Moves|Mercurial Strike]], JA reset
** 888 : [[:Category:Gigas#Common TP Moves|Colossal Slam]]
** 999 : [[:Category:Gigas#Common TP Moves|Colossal Slam]]
** 1111 : [[Meikyo Shisui]] + [[:Category:Gigas#Common TP Moves|Colossal Slam]] x3
* It is recommended to kite if you are hit with a 1111 damage [[:Category:Gigas#Common TP Moves|Mercurial Strike]]. If you fight at max range and start running soon enough, he will not be able to land any [[:Category:Gigas#Common TP Moves|Colossal Slam]]s on you.
** Be careful that you do not run more than 30' away, as this will force you to disengage and likely turn Briareus white.}}

===Sky===
* Melee attacks have Additional effect: Light damage.
**[[Seiryu]]'s [[East Wind]] can dispel this effect if it successfully hits him.
* Casts Dia III, Diaga II, Holy, Banish IV, Banishga III.

===Escha===
*Levels up after each use of disorientating wail (AoE amnesia).
**{{white!}} proc from darkness damage will level Byakko down and remove perfect dodge.
***This can be done with darkness skillchains or dark based nukes.
**You may resist the amnesia with [[Barfire]]/[[Barfira]], [[Baramnesia]]/[[Baramnesra]], and other magic evasion related items.
==History/Background==
Byakko represents one of the four symbols of the Chinese constellations. He is sometimes called "The White Tiger of the West", and represents the West and Autumn.
During the Han Dynasty, they believed a tiger was the king of all animals. Legend said when a tiger was to reach 500 years old, it would turn white. This is how the "White Tiger" became a mythological creature for that time period.

** [[:Category:Pixie#Common TP Moves|Summer Breeze]] - Physical damage mode. Gains [[Double Attack]] and uses [[:Category:Pixie#Common TP Moves|Cyclonic Torrent]] and [[:Category:Pixie#Common TP Moves|Cyclonic Turmoil]].
* [[Stun]] [[:Category:Pixie#Common TP Moves|Winter Breeze]] if at all possible.

==Lore==
The Chonchon is a mythical bird from Mapuche religion also present in Chilean and southern Argentine folk myth that announces misfortune.

The Chonchon has the shape of a human head with feathers and talons. Its ears, which are extremely large, serve as wings for its flight on moonless nights. Chonchons are supposed to be endowed with all the magic powers of the kalku (sorcerors), and can only be seen by other kalkus or by wizards that want this power. Although the fearsome appearance of a chonchon would be invisible to the uninitiated, they would still be able to hear its characteristic cry of "tue tue tue", which is considered to be an extremely ill omen, usually predicting the death of a loved one. [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chonchon#:~:text=The%20Chonchon%20(Spanish%3A%20chonch%C3%B3n%20from,and%20southern%20Argentine%20folk%20myth.]

{{Disambiguation|Tchakka}} {{Adversary Description |Image=Tchakka.png |Class=Delve NM |Type= Aquans |Family= Rockfin |Main.Job= |Sub.Job= |Crystal= |Detects= True Sound |Notes=* Dakuwaqa is the [[Delve]] boss for [[Foret de Hennetiel]]. * Dakuwaqa's HP bar is normally shrouded for the duration of the battle, but is revealed after using '''Carcharian Verve'''. It remains visible so long as his aura remains active and disappears shortly after the aura state is successfully terminated. '''Basic Attacks''' * Normal auto-attacks are chosen from one of three types: ** Bite: Single target physical damage, [[Defense Down]] ** Thrust: Conal physical damage, knockback ** Spins in place: AoE {{water}} damage, knockback '''Damage Resistances and Susceptibilities''' * Dakuwaqa's damage resistances and susceptibilities change throughout the battle, based on remaining HP: ** 100% - 75% HP: Resistant to blunt damage, susceptible to piercing damage ** 74% - 50% HP: Resistant to piercing damage, susceptible to blunt damage ** 49% - 25% HP: Resistant to magic damage, susceptible to slashing damage ** <25% HP: Resistant to slashing damage, susceptible to magic damage ***This knowledge can be used advantageously for timing of SP or other abilities depending on the group setup. For example, a group heavily reliant on blunt damage from monks can use [[Formless Strikes]] to lose the blunt attribute and accelerate the first 25% of the battle, then drop [[Formless Strikes]] and use [[Hundred Fists]] to greatly accelerate the next 25%. * Dakuwaqa can be slept with light-based sleep. '''Techniques''' *'''Carcharian Verve''' is used at each 25% HP threshold (the first move below 75%, 50%, and 25% HP), and randomly below 25% HP. Its two effects should be immediately dispelled (high [[Magic Accuracy]] is needed to Dispel reliably). **'''Carcharian Verve''' is always is quickly followed by '''Marine Mayhem'''. **All non-melee range players should be standing at maximum casting distance to remain out of range of '''Marine Mayhem'''. *All other TP moves (see below) can be used at any time. *Because of '''Tidal Guillotine''''s HP-based instant KO, healers need to be careful to keep the HP of players in range topped off. '''Spells''' *Dakuwaqa's available debuffs and the element of his nukes depend on remaining HP and the tier of nukes cast depend remaining HP and whether the '''Water Spear''' effect is active (see below). The alignment of his elemental spells shifts with each phase: **'''100%-75% HP''' {{water}} / {{ice}} ***Debuffs: Poisonga II, Paralyga, Bindga ***Active: Water IV, Waterga IV, Blizzard IV, Blizzaga IV ***Inactive: Water III, Waterga III, Blizzard III, Blizzaga III **'''74%-50% HP''' {{ice}} / {{wind}} ***Debuffs: Paralyga, Silencega, Graviga ***Active: Blizzard V, Blizzaga IV, Aero IV, Aeroga IV ***Inactive: Blizzard IV, Blizzaga III, Aero III, Aeroga III **'''49%-25% HP''' {{wind}} / {{water}} ***Debuffs: Silencega, Poisonga II, Sleepga ***Active: Water V, Waterja ***Inactive: Aeroga IV, Water IV, Waterga III **'''<25% HP''' {{ice}} / {{water}} ***Debuffs: Sleepga, Silencega, Dispelga ***Active: Blizzard V, Blizzaga V, Water V, Waterga V ***Inactive: Blizzard IV, Blizzaja, Water IV, Waterja '''Water Spear Effect''' * Immediately after using '''Carcharian Verve''', Dakuwaqa will gain a visible magical water spear effect (this effect will activate even if the move is successfully stunned). ** Carcharian Verve is used as the first TP move and every 25% HP thereafter (as the first TP move below 75%, 50%, and 25% HP). **Below 25% HP, Carcharian Verve can be used randomly as a normal TP move whenever the water spear effect is not active. ** Carcharian Verve grants extremely powerful attack and magic attack boost effects to Dakuwaqa (these effects should be dispelled immediately, [[Dispel]] goes through shield and can be used 2x as soon as ATK+ and MATK+ go up). The first several uses of this move are stunnable. Towards the end of the battle (25% and below), '''Carcharian Verve''' and '''Marine Mayhem''' ready almost immediately. '''Carcharian Verve''' is extremely difficult to stun reliably at this point and the amount of time you will have to get ready for '''Marine Mayhem''' will be dramatically reduced. ** Stunning the move prevents the Attack and Magic Attack buffs from activating, but the Water Spear will still activate. * Activation of the water spear modifies Dakuwaqa's abilities and resistances: ** Dakuwaqa is immune to Stun while the effect is active. ** Dakuwaqa will use his highest tier elemental magic spells while the effect is active. ** After each of the scripted uses of Carcharian Verve and activation of the water spear, Dakuwaqa will gain a potent [[Ice Spikes]] effect that lasts for thirty seconds. This is the zone buff for [[Foret de Hennetiel]] and cannot be dispelled. ** After utilizing '''Carcharian Verve''' (even if stunned) and activation of the aura effect, the next utilized TP move will be '''Marine Mayhem'''. *** Marine Mayhem deals water damage in a 0-5' AoE and instantly KOs any players in the 5'-20' AoE around Dakuwaqa. Because of the water spear effect, this move cannot be stunned. *** Marine Mayhem is not used as a random TP move at any point; it is only (and always) used as the next TP move after Carcharian Verve. ** Thunder-based attacks will be less resisted and deal increased damage while the spear is active. *** The spear effect is removed by inflicting a certain amount of thunder elemental attacks or total damage. * Uses AoE Camisado for 500~700 damage and 10' knockback.

|Notes=
*The zone boss for wave 3 of [[Dynamis - San d'Oria (D)]].
:*Is not aggressive and will only act when acted upon.
*Has access to all Sword weapon skills.
:*[[Circle Blade]] is particularly dangerous.
*Reguarly casts [[AoE]] [[Enfeebling Magic]] such as '''Paralyga''' and '''Silencega'''.
:*Susceptible to {{color|wind|silence}}.
*Has innate auto-regain.
*Possesses an innate -80% damage taken trait which may be weakened by 10% for each time an elemental "circle" fetter has been defeated in the zone.
:*In order to beat this boss, it is required that you defeat all 8 circles to be able to maximize your damage output.
*Absorbs {{magical}} magical damage (including skillchains) of the same elements as any undefeated circles still present in the zone.
:*Defeating a circle will change the resistance tiers to 20% (-80%) of that same element and and 100% (-0%) of the opposite element.
::*E.g. Your group has defeated one [[Elemental Circle]] in the zone, a {{color|fire|Fire Circle}}. 
:::*The {{PAGENAME}}'s damage taken trait is now -70%, and no longer absorbs {{fire}} fire damage, but will take -80% damage from it.
::::*{{fire}} Fire damage will deal full damage after defeating the {{color|water|Water Circle}}.
:::*{{ice}} Ice will now deal full damage, but is still absorbed until the {{color|ice|Ice Circle}} has been defeated.
*At each 20% of HP lost interval, it will spawn 4 Volte helpers; ''79%'', ''59%'', ''39%'', and ''19%''.
:*The Volte mobs in each wave will be unique in job so there will be no repeats.
:*Adds will spawn with the same enmity levels of the current focused target from the boss. 
:*The Volte Corsair is particularly dangerous due to "Wild Card" which will grant a "Benediction" affect on the boss healing it to full. Highly suggested to pull Volte Corsair away from the boss and defeat it quickly.
::*This may be difficult as sufficient hate will need to be generated by another party member to shift its focus.
*At any point during the fight, the boss may summon a "Disjoined's Odin" (multiple times) which will perform '''Shin-Zantetsuken''', which is an AoE Death move.
:*This may be prevented by having "Reraise" on your character which will consume the effect upon being hit. 
::*Highly recommend to bring multiple "Reraise" items for this reason.
::*Using the /kneel command may also avoid this move but it is very risky and not advised.
::*It is also possible to be out of range of the move to avoid it as well.
*Characters using the same weapon skills in succession will result in reduced damage dealt by it to the boss. Suggested to rotate weapon skills to work around this deterrent.
:*If any "Volte" helpers are up at this time, it may use the AoE multiple times which will result in a wipe.
*{{PAGENAME}} will use more dangerous and stronger versions of [[Weapon Skills]] as time progresses, in 10 minute intervals from the start of battle.
:*This NM in particular appears to use an AOE{{Verification}} version of [[Chant du Cygne]] for very high damage.
:*This NM gets access to Uryan Blade (Improved wider version of [[Uriel Blade]]) after 30 minutes.
*Will use a various {{icon|sp}} 1 hr job ability every 180 seconds, such as [[Mighty Strikes]], [[Perfect Dodge]] and [[Invincible]].
*If this boss along with the other 3 respective Disjoined bosses have been defeated, it will provide the title ''Judge, Jury and Executioner''.
}}

|Notes=
*Draketrader Zlodgodd exclusively utilizes standard melee attacks and powerful Jumps. Does not use a {{Icon|SP}} 1-Hour ability. 
**Players may avoid Jumps while kiting and being too far away.
*Attack pattern of short (instant) Jumps before a final long charge time Jump.
*Begins the fight using two short Jumps before a long one after every three melee swings.
*Will use fewer melee attacks between each new volley of Jumps as Draketrader Zlodgodd's HP decreases:
**From 70% to 100% it will melee thrice before each round.
**Under 70% it will melee twice before each Jump round.
**Under 35% it will melee once before each Jump round.
*The number of short jumps in a volley will increase as Draketrader Zlodgodd's HP decreases:
::{{{!}} style="border-collapse: collapsed; text-align: center;" cellspacing=0

* The long charge Jump deals greater damage than the rapid Jumps.
* The power of Jump will increase as Draketrader Zlodgodd's HP decreases.
* For five seconds after each Jump, Draketrader Zlodgodd will be in the same state as a Wyrm in flight where melee attacks and melee weapon skills will miss. This will give the same "Too Far Away" message to players that a Wyrm would.
** Due to the volume of jumps, players are effectively floored melee accuracy in this fight. Making mages and range attacks a popular strategy.
* Players are able to sack pull off the nearby bridge and into the river to isolate Draketrader Zlodgodd from the surrounding monsters. 
* Immune to Bind, Break, Gravity, Paralyze, Sleep, and Repose.
* Susceptible to Stun and Slow.
}}

*Is not aggressive and will only attack if acted upon.
*Each circle corresponds to 1 of the 8 elements ({{color|fire|Fire}}, {{color|ice|Ice}}, {{color|wind|Wind}}, {{color|earth|Earth}}, {{color|thunder|Thunder}}, {{color|water|Water}}, {{color|light|Light}}, and {{color|dark|Dark}}).
:*Each circle that is defeated removes a -10% of the innate -80% damage taken on the corresponding Disjoined [[Fomor]] boss for the respective zone.
:*Defeating a a circle will also change the resistance tiers of the Disjoined boss to 20% (-80%) of that same element and and 100% (-0%) of the opposite element.
::*E.g. Your group has defeated one [[Elemental Circle]] in the zone, a {{color|fire|Fire Circle}}. 
:::*The {{PAGENAME}}'s damage taken trait is now -70%, and no longer absorbs {{fire}} fire damage, but will take -80% damage from it.
::::*{{fire}} Fire damage will deal full damage after defeating the {{color|water|Water Circle}}.
:::*{{ice}} Ice will now deal full damage, but is still absorbed until the {{color|ice|Ice Circle}} has been defeated.
*Each circle only has 1 {{magical}} AoE (45') attack which corresponds to it's element.
:*These attacks do significant damage.
:*Players should be properly buffed (Barspells, Shell, [[Geo-Fade]], etc) to mitigate damage.
:*The circle will only AoE if the target with hate is within 15'. 
::*You may avoid these attacks by having the tank get significant hate outside target attack range so that your DDs may kill the circle without worry.
*Upon being aggroed, each circle will spawn a "Disjoined ???" mob of the associated zone boss' race. 
**Defeating the circle will also cause the spawned "Disjoined ???" add to fall.

Aggressive within 5'. **The closest entrance is in [[Batallia Downs (S)]] at (I-6). **Respawn is around 4-5 Hours. *Draws in the entire alliance once aggroed, and draws in the alliance anytime Ethniu's target runs ~20'+ away. **Will also prevent anyone from leaving the room past the lit brazer as well and triggers draw-in back a set spot in the room (152.000, -15.000, 290.000). *Casts Aero IV, Aeroga III, Tornado, Graviga, Silencega, [[Zephyr Mantle]], [[Frightful Roar]], and [[Hecatomb Wave]]. **Levels up after the successful completion of any elemental or enfeebling spell. ***Does not level up after using Blue Magic. ***Stun will prevent the level up. ***Level ups cease after gaining ten levels. **Casts a spell every 25-35 seconds. **Frightful Roar and Hecatomb Wave will bypass, but not remove Utsusemi. *Absorbs {{color|wind|wind damage}}. *Possesses an enspell effect of either Silence or Enaero. **Eneffects do not activate every attack swing, but can activate on each attack in the round.. **Only one eneffect will activate at a time. **Enaero deals 100 a hit while Ensilence deals no damage and lasts for 15-30 seconds. ***Removable with Silena, Echo Drops, etc. *Uses Gust Slash, Cyclone, Evisceration, and standard Fomor TP moves. **Gust Slash and Cyclone will bypass, but not remove Utsusemi. *Under 35%, Ethniu will use {{Icon|SP}} [[Perfect Dodge]] and then reactivate it every 5 minutes. **Gains an invisible silence aura (~20'? {{Information Needed}}) during Perfect Dodge. **Gains an enhanced rate of Triple Attack rate during Perfect Dodge. ***The rate is on the closer end of guaranteed to activate than not. ***Ethniu can deliver up to six attacks in a round with Triple Attack activating on both swings. **Will not cast or use TP moves during Perfect Dodge. *Despawns 2 hours after being claimed. *In the event of a full party/alliance wipe, Ethniu will despawn with the message:
''"You have lost sight of the monster and can no longer sense its presence."'' *Susceptible to Blind, Stun/Violent Flourish and Poison. *Immune to Break, Bind, Gravity, Paralyze, Sleep, Slow, and Silence. ====Enmity==== *As with [[Lugh]], [[Elatha]], [[Buarainech]], and [[Tethra]], Ethniu's enmity is unique. **Focuses on the last person to perform an action without regard for how much enmity an action has. ***Actions include things such as offensive spells, abilities, or weapon skills. ****Missed weapon skills will not count. ***Melee swings and any spells or abilities that do not target it do not count as actions for hate shifting. **Tanks can repeatedly cast Cure and other spells on the target in order to increase their action rate. *Ethniu retaliates to magic being cast on it that pulls hate with an instant cast [[Aero IV]] against the caster. **This will not cause Ethniu to level up. **This also includes casting spells like Flash or Curing Ethniu. **Retaliation with Aero will not interfere with the casting timer for spells. ***After an Aero IV retaliation, if the casting window is up then Ethniu will go right into the spell. *Ethniu retaliates to job abilities and weapon skills used on it that pulls hate with a dagger weapon skill against the user. **This does not consume Ethniu's TP, and as with casting it may immediately utilize a TP move afterwards if able. }} *The zone boss for Dynamis-Windurst [D].
*Spawns near the Mog House entrance after [[Envincing Idol]] has been defeated.
*Grants a 30 minute time extension and the title "''Dynamis-Windurst [D] Infiltrator''" upon defeat.
*Has an extreme degree of [[Fast Cast]] and will cast various spells such as [[Silencega]], [[Stonega IV]] and [[Aeroga IV]].
**Can be silenced by a well geared, capped skill [[Red Mage]] with support.
**Is immune to dark based dispels. <<<<--- '''This is not the case anymore.'''
*Uses TP attacks immediately when available and gains tp rather quickly from damaged received.
*Uses the following TP Moves:
:*'''Feather Storm''': Single target physical {{physical}} damage and poison.
:*'''Double Kick''': Single target physical {{physical}} damage, knockback, and stun.
:*'''Parry''': Gains Defense Boost.
:*'''Sweep''': AoE physical {{physical}} damage and stun.
:*'''Howl''': Gains [[Warcry]]
:*Can use '''[[Perfect Dodge]]''', '''[[Blood Weapon]]''', '''[[Mighty Strikes]]''', and '''[[Hundred Fists]]''' at any time multiple times. Cannot stack 1 hr abilities on top of each other and can only use when the previous one wears off.
*Below '''50%''' HP, {{PAGENAME}} will gain an inhibit TP Aura with a 50 yalm radius. This aura will remain even if the NM recovers health to full after a wipe and retains all tp attacks below 50% hp as well.
*Uses the following TP attacks below 50% HP in addition to the previous ones:
:*'''Feather Fusillade''': Conal physical {{physical}} damage. Additional Effect: Bio + Poison (combined 200/tic)
:*'''Double Punt''': Single target physical {{physical}} damage. Additional Effect: Terror + Knockback.
:*'''Riposte''': Evasion Boost (+100) and very powerful Regen (dispelable/[[Atomos]]able). Lasts 3 minutes.
::*Does not overwrite [[Distract]] or [[Diamond Storm]]. This will also prevent the regen effect.
:*'''Stroke''': AoE (25') high physical {{physical}} damage. Additional Effect: Stun.
:*'''Guttural Roar''': Attack Boost (+50%) and Regain (100/tic) (dispelable/[[Atomos]]able). Lasts 3 minutes.
::*Does not overwrite [[Tidal Roar]]. This will also prevent the regain effect.
:*'''Vorticose Sands''': AoE (~25'+) magical {{magical}} {{wind}} damage. Additional Effect: Silence, Knockback, and Removes 1 piece of equipment.
:*'''Doom''': Single target Doom
:*'''Pristine Evasion''': Enhanced version of [[Perfect Dodge]] that also evades magic.
::*Ranged attacks will still land.
:*'''Sanguine Blessing''': Enhanced version of [[Blood Weapon]] in which drain effect is multiplied by 20 on each melee strike.
:*'''Flailing Blow''': Enhanced version of [[Mighty Strikes]] in which damage dealt from critical hits is multiplied by 1.5.
:*'''Thousand Fists''': Enhanced version of [[Hundred Fists]] ability with added various en-debuffs on attacks (Poison, Blind, Plague, Silence, Paralyze)
*Susceptible to silence.

* Casts nukes (tier 5 nukes, tier 4 -gas) and casts AoE enfeebles.

** Use [[Fool's Drink]] instead of relying on [[Fanatic's Drink]].
** TP on the adds and WS Fjalar after [[:Category:Dvergr#Common_TP_Moves|Thundris Shriek]], but otherwise ignore them.

Once you deal enough damage to it, the rest will depop and you can resume the fight.  He will also use this move more frequently under 25%.
*(Below 50%) '''Tsujikaze''': AoE magical damage + silence, defense down, and magic defense down. ~14.9' range.

* Random spawn on floor 3 as one of three possible mini-bosses.

** May be negated by [[Migawari: Ichi|Migawari]] and is affected by [[Earthen Armor]] and [[Sentinel's Scherzo]].

*** [[Dark Knight]] spamming [[Absorb]] spells between attacks is also effective.

* '''Trinary Tap''' - Absorbs up to 3 status effects. Goes through shadows.
* '''Shadow Spread''' - 10'  AoE Sleep, Blind, Curse, & Plague.
* TP move frequency increases as HP decreases until eventually spamming moves at ~10% HP.
* Has been estimated to have ~1400 evasion, and hits fairly hard (300-800 damage melee hits to non-tanks).

*Has approximately 40,000 HP
*Grannus is a Vermin-type monster, so the [[Vermin Killer]] boon from [[Intimidation Palimpsest]] is effective.

*Assisted by up to five [[Grannus's Firebug]]s. While Grannus is passive, they will spawn over time so there may be up to five when the fight begins depending on how long it takes before engaging. They can be slept and/or kited away.
*Possesses a powerful [[Auto Regen]] effect which increases significantly with the number of Grannus's Firebugs present (~100 HP/tick per Firebug).
*While readying a TP move, gains a temporary potent [[Blaze Spikes]] effect that can do up to 200 damage dependent on the number of Firebugs present.
*Uses standard Wamoura TP moves and one unique TP move:
**'''Erosion Dust''': AoE moderate damage & strong DoT [[Dia]]
**'''Erratic Flutter''': 10' AoE damage, gains [[Haste]]
**'''Exuviation''': Removes all status debuffs and heals for 3000+ HP per debuff.
**'''Proboscis''': Drains MP, deals damage equal to MP drained, and absorbs one positive status effect. 
**'''Magma Fan''': Conal damage.
**'''Benumbing Blaze''' (unique): AoE powerful Fire damage & [[Paralyze]]
*Below 50% HP, uses [[Benediction]] once (this will wake any slept Firebugs in range).
*Defeating Grannus yields the title ''Grannus Garroter''.
[[Category:Meeble Burrows (Batallia)]]}}

|Notes= 
*The respawn was changed from 72 hours to 60-90 minutes in the March 18th 2014 update.
===Getting There===
*A [[M. Tanscale Key]], [[M. Silverscale Key]], and [[M. Blackscale Key]] are required to open the door to Gulool Ja Ja.
*Go to [[Mamook]] via the [[Survival Guide]] or [[Bhaflau Thickets]] [[Home Point]]. 
*The [[M. Silverscale Key]] is from [[Sahagin]] around the pond of (G-7) on the first map, so grab that first.
*The remaining keys are from mamool ja on the way to the door.
*To get to this door, head to J-11 on the first map to change to the other map. There are true sight Mamool Ja on the way, some of which drop the other keys needed.
*The Maghogany Door is at (F-8) on this map. All three keys must be used at the same time on this door. There are true sight Mamool Ja on the way.
===Fight===
*Counter attacks against any magic cast with the usage of '''Vorpal Wheel''' to the caster.
**Will not counter if a spell is resisted, such as Paralyze.
*Gains access to '''Decussate''' at 20% HP.
*Uses {{Icon|SP}} [[Mijin Gakure]] at 2%.
*Summons two [[Mamool Ja Chamberlain]]s (Level 80 WHM, 4,100 HP) and two  [[Mamool Ja Palatine]]s (Level 80 THF, 4,100 HP) during the fight.
**These will be recalled roughly every 40 seconds if defeated. Hate is not linked 
*It is possible to pull to about 30' away from the door, and anyone standing right outside the door will get the title.
**It's not recommended at all though, and Draw-In will make moving difficult.
}}

*Spawns near the open door walkway towards the Mog House entrance (top of M-5 on map) after [[Overseer's Tombstone]] has been defeated.
*Grants a 30 minute time extension and the title "''Dynamis-San d'Oria [D] Infiltrator''" upon defeat.
*'''>50%''', Uses the following TP Moves:
:*'''Howl''' : {{buff}} [[Warcry]] effect
:*'''Armblock''' : {{buff}} Defense Boost
:*'''Battle Dance''' : AoE {{physical}} Damage + [[DEX]] Down.
:*'''Shoulder Charge''': Conal {{physical}} damage + Defense Down.
:*'''Tornado Edge''': Single target {{physical}} damage + Max HP Down + Max MP Down + Max TP Down.
:*'''Invincible''': [[Paladin]]'s [[Invincible]] {{icon|sp}} ability.
:*'''Elemental Sforzo''' : [[Rune Fencer]]'s {{icon|sp}} ability in which all magical damage is nullified
:*'''Mighty Strikes''': [[Warrior]]'s [[Mighty Strikes]] {{icon|sp}} ability.
:*'''Blood Weapon''': [[Dark Knight]]'s [[Blood Weapon]] {{icon|sp}} ability
*At '''≤50%''' HP, Halphas will gain an aura which grants a potent [[Defense Down]] and Avoidance Down effect within a 50' yalm radius.
:*This aura will remain even if the NM recovers health to full after a wipe and retains all tp attacks below 50% hp as well.
*Alongside the aura, he will use the following TP attacks in addition to the previous ones:
:*'''Shriek''': Extremely potent [[Warcry]] and [[Haste]] effects. Highly recommended to [[Dispel]].
:*'''Bilateral Shield''': Potent Defense Boost and removes 1 debuff. Highly recommended to [[Dispel]]. [[Full Break]] overrides this preventing Defense Boost and debuff removal.
:*'''Yarkhushta''': AoE ~700-1,500+ {{physical}} damage + [[Stun]] with a radius of 25.0. This can increase up to 2000-3000 damage with Shriek up.
:*'''Veil of Chaos''': AoE ~1,000 {{magical}} {{light}} damage + [[Knockback]] + [[Amnesia]]
:*'''Orcish Counterstance''' : {{buff}} Very high rate of counter attack and seems to grant an extremely potent haste effect. This move is very dangerous to melees. Melees should fight behind the mob to avoid activation.
:* '''Full-On Tackle''': Single target {{physical}} damage (1000+ damage possible) + Gravity + hate reset (no reset if the move is absorbed by shadows)
:* '''Cyclone Slice''': Cone {{physical}} attack (1000+ damage possible) + Defense Down + Magic Defense Down + TP Max Down
:*'''Repulsor''': Enhanced version of [[Invincible]] that also adds a potent (400~900dmg) [[Reprisal]] effect.
:* '''Aetherwell''': enhanced version of "Elemental Sforzo" in which all magical damage nullified will also be absorbed into HP
:* '''Flailing Blow''': enhanced version of "Mighty Strikes" in which damage dealt from critical hits is multiplied by 1.5
:* '''Sanguine Blessing''': enhanced version of "Blood Weapon" in which drain effect is multiplied by 20 on each melee strike
*{{icon|sp}} 1-Hour Abilities can not be dispelled/absorbed by Thief's job ability, [[Larceny]].
*Is susceptible to [[Mewing Lullaby]].
*[[Gravity]] can land, but does not last long. Recommended to use when tank loses hate.
*Susceptible to [[Threnody]], [[Requiem]], [[Elegy]], and [[Nocturne]].
}}

Huginn was one of [[Odin]]'s two ravens, along with [[Muninn]]. Huginn and Muninn travel the world bearing news and information they have collected to Odin. It is from these ravens that the kenning 'raven-god' for Odin is derived. 
Source: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hugin_and_Munin

* Spawned as part of the quest [[VW Op. 115: Valkurm Duster]].
* Ig-Alima is level 120 with 1059 [[attack]]. [http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/19793-dev1069-Phantom-Roll-Effect-Adjustments-feedback?p=279423&viewfull=1#post279423]
* Casts [[Ice Spikes]], [[Blaze Spikes]], and [[Shock Spikes]].
** Also casts [[Dread Spikes]] at lower HP.
* Has three types of melee strikes:
** Single target triple attack (displayed as one attack, but is actually three attacks and can be absorbed by three shadows)
** Frontal AoE (with [[Stun]] additional effect)
** Radial AoE (with [[Bind]] additional effect) (animation where Ig-Alima punches the ground)
* Uses the following TP moves
** '''Oblivion's Mantle''': Area of Effect high damage, [[weakness]], and 10-count [[doom]].
*** Players killed by the doom effect will return with double weakness due to the initial weakness effect.
** '''Bolt of Perdition''': Conal lightning damage, knockback, [[Mute]], and [[Amnesia]], 30 to 40sec.
** '''Searing Halitus''': Area of Effect fire damage, powerful DoT [[Burn]]
** '''Crippling Rime''': Conal ice damage, all attributes down
** '''Diluvial Wake''': Area of Effect water damage, [[Defense Down]], and [[Magic Defense Down]]
** '''Divesting Gale''': Area of Effect wind damage, [[Encumbrance]], and [[Muddle]]
** '''Kurnugi Collapse''': Area of Effect earth damage, [[Accuracy Down]], and [[Magic Accuracy Down]]
* Can be stunned, but builds resistance quickly.
* As of the February 2012 version update, timing [[Voidwatch Weaknesses|weakness triggers]] properly with TP moves or spells now correctly yields increased alignment/weakness duration on this monster.

|Notes=
*The zone boss for Dynamis-Bastok [D].
*Spawns near the Mog House entrance (bottom left of K-8 on map) after [[Mu'Sha Effigy]] has been defeated.
*Grants a 30 minute time extension and the title "''Dynamis-Bastok [D] Infiltrator''" upon defeat.
*Uses TP attacks immediately when available and gains tp rather quickly from damaged received.
*At <50% HP, he will gain an incredibly potent [[Addle]] and [[Slow]] aura that affects all players within a 50 yalm radius. This aura is shown by the shining diamond shell visual effect on its back. This aura will remain even if the NM recovers health to full after a wipe and retains all tp attacks below 50% hp as well.
*Uses the following TP Moves:
**'''Shell Guard''' : Potent self defense boost (appears to be +100% defense)
**'''Head Butt''' : Single target physical attack with added effect [[stun]]
**'''Shell Bash''' : Single target physical attack with added effect [[stun]] and [[knockback]]
**'''Hellspin''': High physical damage AoE, blockable by shadows
**'''Ore Lob''': Small range AoE physical damage attack around the target
**'''Elemental Sforzo''' : [[Rune Fencer]]'s 1 hr ability in which all magical damage is nullified
**'''Hundred Fists''': [[Monk]]'s [[Hundred Fists]] 1 hr ability
*Uses the following TP attacks below 50% HP in addition to the previous ones:
**'''Skull Smash''' : Single target physical attack with added effect [[stun]]
**'''Ore Hurl''': Conal physical damage attack + added effects of Defense Down and Magic Defense Down
**'''Diamond Shell''' : Self buff which negates all damage dealt to its back, must attack from the side or front to damage
**'''Hell Whirl''': High physical damage AoE (20 yalms) + Bind
**'''Shell Charge''': Conal physical damage attack with added effects of [[Amnesia]] and [[Knockback]]
**'''Wrath of Gu'Dha''': AoE magical damage attack + added effects of [[knockback]] and [[Gravity]]
**'''Torment of Gu'Dha''': AoE moderate magical damage attack + added effects of Defense Down, [[Slow]], and [[Petrify]]
**'''Aetherwall''' : Enhanced version of [[Elemental Sforzo]] which absorbs all magic damage dealt to it
**'''Repulsor''': Enhanced version of [[Invincible]] that also adds a potent (400~900dmg) [[Reprisal]] effect.
***Can be used repeatedly.
**'''Thousand Fists''': Enhanced version of [[Monk]]'s [[Hundred Fists]] ability with added various en-debuffs on attacks (Poison, Blind, Plague, Silence, Paralyze)
*1 hr abilities cannot be dispelled/absorbed by Thief's job ability, [[Larceny]].
*Advised to use [[light]] based skillchains in conjunction with magic bursting [[Thunder]] based spells for maximum damage output. 
}}

|Notes=
* Absorbs {{physical}} physical damage during TP moves and {{magical}} magic damage (including skillchain damage) while casting.
* Has access to Comet, Holy, Drain, and Aspir, eventually casting Impact around 60% and then switching to Comet (AoE), Meteor, Drain III, and Aspir III.
* Uses '''Manafont''' as it approaches 50%, but may use it as early as 85%.
* TP Moves:
** '''Stygian Sphere''' - Self-healing and multi-erase. Does not grant Kin a shield effect.
** '''Malign Invocation''' - AoE damage and [[Amnesia]].
** '''Diabolic Claw''' - Single target damage and Magic Defense Down.
** '''Deathly Diminuendo''' - AoE [[Bio]] and [[Curse]].
** '''Hellish Crescendo''' - AoE damage and [[Paralyze]].
** '''Stygian Cyclone''' - AoE damage and [[Silence]].
** '''Interference''' - Gains access at 25% HP. Inflicts substantial magical damage.
*** Additional effects: [[Dispel]] and [[Knockback]].
*** Damage can be resisted, but Dispel cannot.
*** Kin's version of '''Interference''' hits harder than other [[Caturae]] because Kin is a [[Black Mage]] and therefore has high amounts of [[Magic Atk. Bonus]].
**** [[Indi-Fade]] or [[Dark Carol]] strongly advised to reduce the damage.
** '''Death Sentence''' - Inflicts a 10-tick [[Doom]] effect on the player.
*** [[Indi-Vex]] and [[Indi-Attunement]] do affect the land rate of Doom.
*** Only used if either a [[NIN]], [[PLD]] or [[RUN]] has hate.
**** The job does not matter, '''Death Sentence''' is actually caused by one player having significantly higher [[Cumulative Enmity]] than the player below themselves on Kin's hate list.
**** If you only use [[Volatile Enmity]] for keeping hate on Kin, if you avoid using spells like [[Flash]] and [[Foil]] too much, then Kin will never use '''Death Sentence'''.
** '''Target''' - Uses at 75%/50%/25%/10% HP. Causes Kin's eyes to light up but gives no discernible effect to the player, but does enable the following attack.
*** '''Eleventh Dimension''' - Inflicts a 3:00 duration [[Terror]] effect on the player Target was used on. Used after 1:30 has passed since '''Target''' activation.

* The '''Target''' / '''Eleventh Dimension''' combo can be negated by a party member moving above the targeted player on Kin's [[Enmity]] list. Kin gains Damage Taken -% while Target is active so this can be difficult if the '''Target''' player has too much hate.
::''Example'': Player #1 is highest on Kin's enmity list and has Target used on him.
:::Kin's eyes are now glowing, and Player #1 is now vulnerable to '''Eleventh Dimension'''.
::However, if Player #2 takes enmity off Player #1 Kin's eyes will stop glowing and it will consequently lose access to '''Eleventh Dimension'''. 
:::Kin will have to re-use '''Target''' before it gains access to that attack again.  
* [[High Jump]], [[Super Jump]], [[Accomplice]], [[Pacifying Ruby]] and [[Caper Emissarius]] are all great abilities for breaking the '''Target''' lock.
** [[Cover]] being used on the player with '''Target''' lock will instantly break the lock and prevent '''Eleventh Dimension'''. This also works when [[Cover]] is used from a subjob.
** [[Cover]] ability from trust [[Monberaux]] also work reliably.
}}

|Notes= 
*''Exploitable Weakness'': Damage multipliers increase when Kurma takes magic damage or utilizes certain TP moves.
**The damage multiplier damage dealt to Kurma will continuously increase with the utilization of each TP move except '''Tortoise Song'''. Magic damage multipliers in particular can be boosted extremely high (up to 800% or more).
*** Kurma has extremely high [[magic evasion]], but will take much higher than normal damage even on partial resists if the multiplier is sufficiently boosted. Continuously dealing magic damage with low tier Thunder and Aero spells can significantly speed up the battle. Thunder- and Wind-based magic are the least resisted and [[Magic Accuracy]] boosting effects are recommended to ensure spells land for full damage. 
**Any accumulated damage multipliers will reset whenever '''Tortoise Song''' is used.
*The Defense Boost effect from '''Harden Shell''' is dispellable but requires extremely high magic accuracy (including player buffs and magic evasion reducing effects on Kurma) to land reliably. 
*'''Testudo Tremor''' is only used below 50% HP and deals severe earth-based damage as well as Stun and Weight effects. Abilities which resist earth damage are useful to reduce the extreme damage.
}}

It is trivial for any Level 99 player, let alone any in [[ilvl]] equipment.
[[File:Lilith 1.png|190px|link=]]
====Lady Lilith==== * DNC/BLM, ~9,800 HP. * Immune to {{color|wind|Silence}} and '''Sle'''{{color|light|ep}}, and is resistant to {{color|thunder|Stun}}. * Regular auto-attacks are AoE {{magical}} {{dark}} darkness, remove shadows, and cause knockback. * Casts [[Comet]] and, at low HP, [[Meteor]]. * Additionally casts Breakga, Dispelga, Silencega, Graviga, Bindga, and Slowga. *Uses the following moves: :*'''Dark Thorn''': {{buff}} Gains {{color|fire|Dread Spikes}} and {{color|earth|Stoneskin}}. :*'''Durance Whip''': Conal {{physical}} Damage, '''Bio''', {{color|ice|Bind}}, and {{color|fire|Amnesia}}. :*'''Moonlight Veil''': AoE {{magical}} {{dark}} Damage, Terror, and spawns a Dark Gyve. ::*Proceeded by dialogue. :*'''Petaline Tempest''': {{magical}} Damage, Max HP, MP, and TP down. :*'''Subjugating Slash''': Conal Damage, Knockback, and Dispels 3 enhancements. :*{{icon|SP}} [[Trance]] at 50% and then freely thereafter. ::*While under trance, Lilith gains access to '''Fatal Allure''' a gaze-based {{color|light|Charm}}. :::*This may be avoided by turning away from her.
[[File:Lilith 2.png|130px|link=]]
====Lilith Ascendant==== *WHM/BLM, ~17,000 HP. * Immune to {{color|wind|Silence}} and '''Sle'''{{color|light|ep}}, and is resistant to {{color|thunder|Stun}}. *Uses the following moves: :*'''Dark Burst''': Conal {{magical}} {{thunder}} Damage, {{color|thunder|Stun}}, resets all ability timers, and summons a {{color|thunder|Thunder Gyve}}. :*'''Dark Flare''': Conal {{magical}} {{fire}} Damage, TP reset, Enmity reduction, and summons a {{color|fire|Fire Gyve}}. :*'''Dark Flood''': Conal {{magical}} {{water}} Damage, {{color|fire|Encumbrance}}, Knockback, and summons a {{color|water|Water Gyve}}. :*'''Dark Freeze''': Conal {{magical}} {{ice}} Damage, {{color|earth|Terror}}, Enmity reduction, and summons an {{color|ice|Ice Gyve}}. :*'''Dark Quake''': AoE {{magical}} {{earth}} Damage, {{color|ice|Bind}}, {{color|fire|Amnesia}}, and summons an {{color|earth|Earth Gyve}}. :*'''Dark Tornado''': AoE {{magical}} {{wind}} Damage, full '''Dispel''', Knockback, and summons a {{color|wind|Wind Gyve}}. :'''<50%''', Gains and will use dialogue before these moves: :*'''Dark Moon''': AoE {{magical}} {{dark}} Damage, Weakness, and summons two '''Dark Gyves'''. :*'''Dark Sun''':AoE {{magical}} {{light}} Damage, chance of Death, and summons two {{color|light|Light Gyves}}. ---- ===Maiden of the Dusk ★=== :As part of the [[High-Tier Mission Battlefield]] *The [[Maiden phantom gem]] {{KI}} is only accessible after completing the mission [[Maiden of the Dusk]]. *Unlike other similar fights such as [[Odin Prime|A Stygian Pact]] ★, offensive [[Geomancy]] potency is ''not'' reduced based on the fight difficulty. *After being struck with a Blood Pact, she will take 90% less damage from Blood Pacts for 10 seconds. This includes multi-hit Blood Pacts, so they should not be used. *While [[Perfect Defense]] will reduce damage taken, neither it nor [[Asylum]] will outright prevent the enfeebling effects of Lilith's TP moves. :*These moves (excluding Fatal Allure) may still be resisted, but this becomes increasingly more difficult on higher difficulties. *Has about 200k HP on Very Easy. ====Gyves ★==== *Once the fight commences, the battlefield will become encircled with [[Gyves]]. :*These Gyves may not be targeted or attacked. :*Players outside of this circle may not deal damage to Lilith. ::*Spite Wardens however, ''will'' take damage outside of this circle. :*These Gyves will attack players which come within a distance of 6'. ::*Summoned Gyves will not attack. *Gyves absorb all forms of {{magical}} magic damage.
[[File:Dark Gyve.png|101px|link=]]
*Lady Lilith summons '''Dark Gyves''' after utilizing a TP move. :*These have a magic evasion down aura. :*Additionally, a 5-count Doom aura is added, beginning on "Normal" difficulty and higher. ::*Only players with enmity towards Lilith will be afflicted by the effects of summoned Gyves. :::*Attacking summoned Gyves or Wardens will not incur enmity against Lady Lilith. :*Summoned Gyves will not despawn; even after Lilith Ascendant appears.
[[File:Light Gyve.png|101px|link=]]
*Lilith Ascendant summons {{color|light|Light Gyves}} after utilizing a TP move. :*These have a [[ST20|Zombie]] and powerful Dia aura. :*Each Gyve present will reduce the damage Lilith Ascendant receives. ::*Lilith Ascendant becomes immune to damage once ''five'' {{color|light|Light Gyves}} have been summoned. ====Spite Wardens★====

Ignores shadows.

====Lady Lilith ★==== * Immune to '''Sle'''{{color|light|ep}}, and is resistant to {{color|wind|Silence}} and {{color|thunder|Stun}}. *Uses the following moves: :*'''Dark Thorn''': {{buff}} Gains a dispelable '''Dread Spikes''' and removes one enfeebling effect. ::*Not used with difficulty set to "Very Easy". :*'''Durance Whip''': Conal {{physical}} Damage, '''Bio''', {{color|ice|Bind}}, and {{color|fire|Amnesia}}. :*'''Fatal Allure''': Conal Gaze {{color|light|Charm}} and 60 second {{color|water|Poison}}. ::*Charm may be avoided by facing away from Lilith. ::*Not used with difficulty set to "Very Easy". :*'''Moonlight Veil''': AoE {{magical}} {{dark}} Damage and Magic Defense Down. :*'''Petaline Tempest''': {{magical}} Damage, Max HP, MP, and TP down (1,000 max). :*'''Subjugating Slash''': Damage and Enmity Reset. ::*Deals 37.5% of Max HP during "Very Easy" difficulty. ::*Deals 75% of Max HP during "Easy," "Normal", "Difficult", and "Very Difficult" difficulties. ::*Bypasses reduction methods such as -Damage Taken, [[Sentinel's Scherzo]], [[Perfect Defense]], etc.

==Getting There==
*Take the [[Nyzul Isle Staging Point]] and then the teleporter at (H-8).
**Then the dim teleporter to the east and proceed forward to the zone to [[Caedarva Mire]].
*The Content Level 135 Unity warp to Caedarva Mire for Shedu puts you right there.
**requires either the [[Captain Wildcat badge]] or a [[Remnants Permit]], otherwise you will not be offered the warp.
*The zone is full of True Sight [[Imp]]s and [[Soulflayer]]s.
*The pop is then at the lake in (H-7).
==The Fight==
* Recommended to pull to [[Khimaira]]'s area or the Stone Tablet.
* Casts single-target and AoE elemental magic, and single target enfeebling magic.
** Can be [[Stun]]ned with [[Head Butt]].
* Uses all [[:Category:Soulflayer|Soulflayer]] TP moves, gaining access to '''Reprobation''' (full AoE Dispel) at low HP.
* Uses '''Immortal Shield''' at and gains two shields rotating around him.
** These shields dramatically reduce melee damage (90%?) and annul magic damage.
** To remove the shields, do the equivalent of about 3,000 magic damage otherwise.
** When the shields are removed, he will use Mind Purge (full target dispel) on whoever has hate.
* Weak to {{Lightning}} {{color|Lightning|Lightning}}, {{Light}} {{color|Light|Light}}, {{Dark}} {{color|Dark|Dark}}.

Sleep |Absorbs= |Assisted.By=Nga Manawa }} }} ==Lore== * Mahuika is the Maori goddess of fire, an ancestress of Māui. When mortals lost the utility of fire, Māui sought out Mahuika's secret of using it on command. Māui begged of her to give him the gift of fire, and she removed one of her five fingers (each representing her five Fire Children) and gave it to him. Māui deviously took it away and extinguished it. He returned to Mahuika and told her it had gone out. This pattern continued until only one finger remained. Mahuika was enraged, removed her last child, and hurled it at Māui, causing a massive fire. Māui narrowly escaped.

[[Nga Manawa]], spawned in the same battlefield, is named after the collective name of Mahuika's five Fire Children.

*Will level up if a skillchain is repeated before using totally different skillchains a certain number of times. 
**Using a sequence such as: Level 2 Dark ([[Gravitation]]) → Level 1 Dark ([[Compression]]) → Level 2 Ice ([[Distortion]]) → Level 1 Ice ([[Induration]]) → Repeat, and it never levels up. 

*Maju will use '''Oppressive Glare''' if it is not blinded and its eyes will glow orange. During which it:
**Will inflict Terror and  Zombie statuses on players facing Maju's gaze. Turning your back before this will prevent this.
**Gains a massive Regen, around 1% per tic.
**Has an effect which causes enmity to become unstable.
*Blind can be used to prevent/take off '''Oppressive Gaze''' which is signified by a red [[File:Red.png|link=]] proc when blind lands.
**However, Maju is very resistant to blind, even with [[Bolster]] [[Geo-Languor]]/[[Geo-Focus]]/[[Elemental Seal]]. Spamming Blind for [[Immunobreak]] is usually required.
***Increasing the magic accuracy of players, and reducing the magic evasion of Maju will increase the rate of [[Immunobreak]]s occurring.
*[[Benediction]] also cures through '''Oppressive Glare''' as a last resort if your tank becomes inflicted with it.
**[[Full Cure]] does not cure through it.
*'''Backdraft''' is a powerful fire {{fire}} based move which will knock targets back and inflict a powerful [[Burn]] DoT and Gravity on those in the AoE.
**AoE is centered on the tank and has a narrow range. Players and Loupans ''directly'' behind Maju at ~4.5'+ will be able to avoid this move. This assumes the tank is not standing inside Maju.
**This move can be significantly reduced in damage to a target by using [[Barfira]] and other magic evasion buffs.
**This move also will not remove shadows.

*'''Delta Thrust''' may occasionally spike in damage dealt to a tank or easily K.O. a mage or DD in general.
**Using shadows, boosting the defense of the target, or reducing Maju's attack power will significantly reduce the potential of this move.

*Using [[Barparalyzra]] and an [[Accession]] with [[Divine Caress]] [[Paralyna]] from a well geared [[White Mage]] is effective at reducing and completely preventing paralyze from landing on players from '''Torpefying Charge'''.

*Melee accuracy caps at ~1700

***Transmogrification: Absorbs all physical damage and converts it into restored HP for ~30 seconds.
**"Sword Form:" Warrior, geared toward Weapon Skill-like attacks and TP-based AOE status abilities. Extremely fast attack speed; Utsusemi is hard to maintain against this form. 
***Velocious Blade: 5x attack, high damage. 
***Sonic Blade: AOE high damage. 
***Scission Thrust: Directional AOE low damage. 
**"Staff Form:" Black Mage, casts AOE -ga magic; susceptible to physical attack. Slow attack speed.
***Psychomancy: AOE Aspir, drains 80+ MP from everyone in range. 
***Mind Wall: Gives the Mammet a special Magic Shield effect, causing it to absorb and regain HP from all offensive magic used against it for ~30 seconds. Does not protect against Astral Flow or elemental weapon skills. 
**"Polearm Form:" Dragoon, geared toward heavy physical attack; slow attack speed.
***Percussive Foin: Directional AOE medium damage. 
***Microquake: Single-target high damage. 
***Gravity Wheel: AOE high damage and Gravity. 
**All forms can use Tremorous Tread: AOE low damage and Stun, absorbed by Utsusemi.
}}

|Notes= 
*Uses standard Gnat attacks and Booming Bombination.
**'''Booming Bombination''' - Large AoE damage + plague + defense down + magic defense down, gains temporary aura of amnesia, silence, and poison.  Appears to increase its damage taken resistance.
*''Exploitable Weaknesses'': 
**Balancing damage dealt between Physical, Non-Elemental, Magical, and Ranged type damage is important. If too much of one damage type is dealt, it will deal reduced damage until more of another type is dealt. 
**'''Emetic Discharge''' transfers all debuffs on itself to combatants in range.  This TP move appears to lower damage resistance and evasion based on the number of transferred debuffs.
*** Selecting debuffs that will affect your DDs minimally is recommended because of Emetic Discharge. Dia, Threnody, Requiem, Nocturne/Addle, Poison, etc. Geomancer debuffs are also very useful as they cannot be transferred by Emetic Discharge.
***Mastop will preferentially use Emetic Discharge (transfers debuffs to all players in range) if multiple debuffs are on. This will limit or prevent usage of Booming Bombination.
*** If you Helix Mastop, and he performs '''Emetic Discharge''', the Helix will get transferred to everyone in range
*** Therefore, if you Helix for 2.5k+ this will likely one shot everyone in the party
* Keeping Barstonra and Barpetra up throughout the fight, and all mages carry echo drops is highly recommended.
*Outside the fracture (in [[Ceizak Battlegrounds]]), the monster depops after 20 minutes
}}

|Image=     
|Class=    VWNM
|Type=Plantoids
|Family=Belladonna
|Main.Job=
|Sub.Job=
|Crystal=  
|Detects= 
|Notes=
*Assisted by up to six '''Ravishing Rafflesia'''.
** All six Ravishing Rafflesia will initially spawn several seconds after the fight begins.
** They will only attack normally and use TP move '''Bloody Caress''' (single target HP drain).
* Morta's physical attacks can be one of three types:
** Single target
** Frontal AoE
** Radial AoE (centered on Morta) with knockback.
* Morta has an innate [[Critical Hit Rate]] penalty of about 25%.
* Casts various earth elemental nukes ([[Stone IV]], [[Stone V]], [[Quake II]], [[Stonega III]], Stonega IV, [[Stoneja]]) and dark magic (AoE [[Drain]], AoE [[Aspir]], [[Impact]])
** Can use [[Chainspell]] multiple times throughout the battle (Morta will not particularly focus on spell casting during Chainspell and will continue to melee and use TP moves as normal).
* Uses the following TP moves:
** '''Full Bloom''': Absorbs one Ravishing Rafflesia to recover 10% HP (~27,000), erase negative status effects, and gain a potent [[Stoneskin]] effect.
*** Keeping Ravishing Rafflesia out of range of Morta ''will not'' prevent this move from occurring.
** '''Atropine Spore''': AoE (conal) damage, [[Sleep]], [[Paralyze]], and [[Silence]].
** '''Night Stalker''': AoE (conal) damage and TP reset
** '''Deracinator''': AoE (radial, centered on Morta) damage, [[Amnesia]], [[Bind]], and [[Muddle]]
** If all Ravishing Rafflesia have been defeated or absorbed, Morta will use one of the following TP moves:
*** '''Beautiful Death''': AoE charm that transforms players into Rafflesia with a 9-count doom effect (guaranteed death since a charmed player cannot be [[Cursna]]-ed)
*** '''Frond Fatale''': AoE charm and resummons all Ravishing Rafflesia.
[[Category:Voidwatch]]}}

*Can spawn in any of the 9 chambers of Einherjar, after a certain time has elapsed. Exact time is unknown.
*Can not spawn if one of the following mobs have spawned: [[Huginn]], [[Saehrimnir]], [[Heithrun]].
*Will despawn after being idle too long. Exact time before despawn is unknown.
*After being killed, the remaining enemies in Einherjar will be weakened. This also applies to any waves of enemies that have yet to spawn.
===History/Backround===
Muninn was one of [[Odin]]'s two ravens, along with [[Huginn]]. Huginn and Muninn travel the world bearing news and information they have collected to Odin. Huginn is "thought" and Muninn is "memory". They are sent out at dawn to gather information and return in the evening. They perch on the god's shoulders and whisper the news into his ears. It is from these ravens that the kenning 'raven-god' for Odin is derived. 
Source: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hugin_and_Munin

{{Disambiguation|Colkhab}} {{Adversary Description |Image=Colkhab.png |Class=Delve NM |Type=Vermin |Family=Bztavian |Main.Job= |Sub.Job= |Crystal= |Detects= True Sound |Notes=*Muyingwa is the [[Delve]] boss for [[Ceizak Battlegrounds]]. *Muyingwa's HP bar is normally shrouded for the duration of the battle, but revealed briefly when upon readying and attempting to use '''Incisive Apotheosis'''. *Muyingwa has extremely high evasion (900+) at all times. '''Basic Attacks''' *Normal auto-attacks are chosen from one of three types: **Bite: Single target physical damage, knockback **Slash: Conal physical damage, knockback **Stinger shot: AoE damage, Poison (-50HP/tick) '''Damage Resistances''' *Beginning at 75% HP, Muyingwa becomes increasingly resistant to most forms of damage as the fight continues, taking only about 10~15% of normal damage towards the end of the battle. **Ranged attacks and any attacks which ignore special defenses (such as [[Requiescat]]) are not susceptible to this damage resistance and will continue to deal normal damage for the duration of the battle. '''Abilities''' *'''Droning Whirlwind''' is used at each 25% HP threshold (the first move below 75%, 50%, and 25% HP) to activate the Blink Whirlwind effect. It is not used at any other time. **If the Whirlwind remains active, '''Droning Whirlwind''' is quickly followed by '''Incisive Apotheosis''' (conal high damage, Enmity reset, and brief [[Weakness]] effect). **'''Droning Whirlwind''' is used ''immediately'' upon dropping below the 75%, 50%, and 25% HP thresholds, regardless of TP. If Muyingwa is currently using another TP move or a spell, she will begin readying '''Droning Whirlwind''' as soon as the current TP move or spell is finished (sometimes even beginning during the end of the animations). *Below 50% HP, '''Incisive Apotheosis''' can be used again (but is not guaranteed) if TP permits and the aura remains active after the initial use of '''Incisive Apotheosis'''. *Below 25% HP, '''Incisive Apotheosis''' can be utilized as a normal TP move. *All other TP moves (see table below) can be used at any time. *Muyingwa will occasionally use two TP moves back to back. The combinations include '''Mandibular Lashing''', '''Stinger Volley''', and '''Vespine Hurricane''' only. Be wary of the zombie effect on '''Stinger Volley''' when attempting to cure. **'''Incisive Denouement''' and '''Incisive Apotheosis''' are ''never'' used as the first or second TP moves in a consecutive combination, even below 25% HP. '''Spells''' *Muyingwa's spells are generally wind-based.
