background-color: #ccf;" | May contains spoilers - click on "Expand" to read more --> |- | * Nanaa Mihgo is leader of the burglar's hideout in Windurst Woods with 2 underlings. * In the mithran conflict over the selection of the next Chieftainess of Windurst, seems to be uninterested in the chieftainness's bow but could be considered a rival of [[Semih Lafihna]] for the succession since Nanaa's not a Sibyl Guard, and therefore would be considered someone of 'real' mithran heritage. * Likes collecting [[Yagudo Bead Necklace]]s, which the Yagudo theomilitary use as a type of Rosary (prayer beads). * Has another hideout between the Rose Tower and Lily Tower of the Horutoto Ruins, which is in a hidden underground location. * She hides her treasures in her kitty : which either takes the meaning of a pool of money or the second hideout, but some vulgar usage causes some dialog and the headlines on the tarutaru news reports to sound funny or wrong. |} =====Rise of the Zilart===== {| role="presentation" class="toccolors mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="max-width:94%" | style="text-align: left; background-color: #ccf;" | May contains spoilers - click on "Expand" to read more --> |- | * Nanaa Mihgo has supernatural abilities that reference a type of magic that could be referred to as card tricks, close-up magic, or mentalist reading ability. ** Includes the ability to know what's written on something she touches without looking at it, and the ability to make objects disappear. ** The Sibyl Guards have been unable to convict her of crimes because the evidence is never found. * Wears the same outfit as the current [[Kazham]] chieftainess, [[Jakoh Wahcondalo]]. * Nanaa Mihgo was thought to have been a member of a larger criminal syndicate, but no trace of these criminals could be found and any memories of these encounters and any memories of involved parties have been erased. ** The criminals were thought to communicate by [[Rune Fencer|delivering letters]] containing hidden meanings, about the goods they were fencing. |} =====Chains of Promathia===== {| role="presentation" class="toccolors mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="max-width:94%" | style="text-align: left; background-color: #ccf;" | May contains spoilers - click on "Expand" to read more --> |- | * Confirmed to be the daughter of the former [[Kazham]] chieftainess, [[Romaa Mihgo]]. ** Note: Mithra cubs are not genetically related to their mothers. Orphans are found by adventurers and either raised as their own or sent back to the homeland to be taken care of by other mithra. [[Twinstone Bonding|Twinstones]] are made into earrings to link the mother and cub. |} =====Wings of the Goddess===== {| role="presentation" class="toccolors mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="max-width:94%" | style="text-align: left; background-color: #ccf;" | May contains spoilers - click on "Expand" to read more --> |- | * [[Romaa Mihgo (S)]] is implied to be carrying a child in the womb at the end of the storyline. ** It may seem like a contradiction of the Rise of the Zilart lore, however : *** The people in the Shadowreign areas are incorrect about the current year since they use the positions of the stars to determine the current date, and the stars are not where they're supposed to be. *** The Rise of the Zilart version of Windurst has a timekeeping problem too, where the crystalline lenses in their telescopes originate from demons of the land of illusions. ** The child would've been given to her by [[Lehko Habhoka]] *** He may have implanted a piece of his soul for reincarnation, as suggested by an ominous journey ahead (he already did a task resembling the headstone pilgrimage in his earlier quests, so it's not that) and message that Romaa would be waiting forever for his return. A similar ability is connected to the descendants of the Holy City of Adoulin, demons of Tartarus, the forbidden art of the Windurstian manustery in the Windurst Allegience missions, and other possibilities. |} =====Kupo Missions===== {| role="presentation" class="toccolors mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="max-width:94%" | style="text-align: left; background-color: #ccf;" | May contains spoilers - click on "Expand" to read more --> |- | * Nanaa Mihgo uses a weapon skill called King Cobra Clamp, an improved version of the Cobra Clamp used by Romaa Mihgo. ** The entry item to Nanaa Mihgo's battle is the Navaratna talisman. |} ====Earthen Lore==== {| role="presentation" class="toccolors mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="max-width:94%" | style="text-align: left; background-color: #ccf;" | May contains spoilers - click on "Expand" to read more --> |- | * Nanaa Mihgo's outfit is modeled after the Diamonds suit playing card. ** She has a unique set of 9 markings on her face. ** This would make her the true Nine of Diamonds. * Scotland lore ** The Nine of Diamonds is referred to has the "Curse of Scotland", after the theft of the 9 crown jewels of Mary Queen of Scots. ** The English name "Mary" in Scottish would usually translate to "Maura". *** The Mithra who stole the jewel from the Halls of the Gods in Zilart Missions is named "Maryoh", **** Maryoh wears a few pieces of the THF AF attire but not the full set: it's the same pieces you'll receive during the quests that Nanaa Mihgo is involved in. * Hindi lore ** Navaratna from the Kupo Missions lore refers to the 9 Gems in Hindi ** The gems themselves are a reference to the 9 Holds or Nava Graha in the holy language of Sanskrit. |}

|Notes= 
* Minimum respawn time of one hour.
* Placeholder ID is 62.
* The Tundra Tiger placeholder has a respawn timer of five minutes.
** One of the two Doll mobs in the area may respawn as a [[Tundra Tiger]]: This tiger is not a placeholder.
* The Goblins in the area are aggressive to characters as high as level 60. The placeholder, however, can be targeted through the wall of the tower, and [[Chi Blast]] can be used through it to pull him.
* He does not link with the [[Goblin's Tiger]] in the area.
* If you have aggro outside the tower, don't despair. The goblins have a fairly low attack speed, and it is possible to zone into [[Pso'Xja]] inside the tower without killing them.
* Can be soloed, although not easily, by a level 45 [[Monk]]/[[Thief]] with evasion gear, [[Hundred Fists]] and a few [[Hi-Potion]]s.
== Background/History ==
The Nue is a legendary creature in Japanese folklore. It is depicted as having a monkey's head, a body of a Raccoon dog, and the legs of a tiger, with a snake instead of a tail. This Chimera-esque creature can transform into a black cloud and fly. Nues are supposed to be bringers of misfortune and illness.

* [[Deadly Dodo]]

*** If spikes were stolen with Orthrus at 1% while he was casting on himself, it used to be possible for him to kill himself this way and yield no drops. Allegedly it is no longer possible. Test at your own risk.
* Heavily resists both Light and Dark spells, which makes it difficult to proc with [[Flash]], [[Light Threnody]], [[Dark Threnody]], and [[Dispel]] even with [[Elemental Seal]].}}

====Ouryu Cometh====
*A BCNM fight with a maximum of 18 members and a 1 hour time limit. Requires a [[Cloud Evoker]] to enter.
*Special Attacks: [[Invincible]] (Multiple times), [[Stonega III]], [[Stoneskin]], [[Breakga]], [[Break]], [[Draw In]], [[Auto-Regen]].
*Uses standard Wyrm attacks: [[:Category:Wyrm#Common_TP_Moves|Bai Wing]], [[:Category:Wyrm#Common_TP_Moves|Absolute Terror]], [[:Category:Wyrm#Common_TP_Moves|Ochre Blast]], [[:Category:Wyrm#Common_TP_Moves|Geotic Breath]], [[:Category:Wyrm#Common_TP_Moves|Horrid Roar]], [[:Category:Wyrm#Common_TP_Moves|Spike Flail]], [[:Category:Wyrm#Common_TP_Moves|Touchdown]].
*Bai Wing has an add-effect of [[Slow]].
*Stays on the ground for 2 minutes, and flies for roughly 2 minutes.
*Attacks in the air are earth based magic damage.
*2 elementals will aggro, an [[Earth Elemental]] and a [[Water Elemental]]. They do eventually build a resistance to sleep.
*4 [[Ziryu]]s will aggro, however it is possible to position Ouryu so that only one is in range to attack. They can be [[Charm]]ed.
*Touchdown, while not requiring TP to use, will reset Ouryus TP to 0% upon use.
*Requires [[Elemental Seal]] to reliably land sleep.
*Ouryu is Earth based, and is therefore immune to Stun, Slow and Elegy.
====The Savage II====
*Fought in [[Monarch Linn]] with a [[Savage's phantom gem]].
**Everyone participating must have this key item in order to enter.
*See [[The Savage II Battle Strategies]]
}}

===Spawning===
*To spawn in [[:Category:Vagary#Duskbrood_Gate:_Putraxia|Duskbrood Gate]]:
** Defeat [[:Category:Elemental|elementals]] with tier IV and V spells according to their weakness five times.
*** [[Blue Magic]], at least the 8 learned hybrid elemental spells, also works.
***  You can also hit the hybrid elementals with either of their weaknesses.
** Perform a 4-step skillchain.
*** e.g. A [[Samurai]] with [[Soboro Sukehiro]]/[[Norifusa]]/[[Norifusa +1|+1]] can do [[Tachi: Jinpu]] four times.
*** e.g A [[Paladin]] with a [[Mercurial Sword]] using [[Sickle Moon]] > [[Freezebite]] > [[Sickle Moon]] > [[Freezebite]]
** Defeat [[:Category:Elemental|elementals]] with magic bursts five times.
===Fighting===
*Warps away if any player is KOed before popping or during the fight and if not [[File:Red.png|23px|link=]] proced for a certain amount of time.
*Extends the time limit by 15 minutes upon defeat.
*Starting at 90% HP, Perfidien changes elemental weakness every 10~15%, marked with a {{icon|SP}} animation.
:*The color of the {{icon|SP}} cloud represents the element Perfidien is strong to. The element he's weak to is two elements ascendant from the cloud color.
:*Will change resistances tiers to 130% for the susceptible element and will then {{color|blue|absorb}} that element's opposite affinity.
::*E.g. If {{water}} {{color|water|water}} is healing Perfidien, then {{thunder}} {{color|thunder|thunder}} magic will be it's weakness.
::*E.g. If {{thunder}} {{color|thunder|thunder}} is healing Perfidien, then {{earth}} {{color|earth|earth}} magic will be it's weakness, etc.
::*Healing Perfidien will cause [[Encumbrance]] with duration based on the damage dealt.
:::*For example, healing for over 7,500 damage will cause over 2 minutes of encumbrance.
::*Healing Perfidien enough will cause it to use '''Vivisection''' and level up.
:::*Use low damaging elemental attacks to probe for the weakness.
::*Skillchains of multiple elements such as Light or Dark, will inflict the damage Perfidien is absorbing.
:*[[File:Blue.png|link=]] proc and an /emote message appears when first inflicting the weakness.
:*[[File:Red.png||link=]] proc appears when dealing ~23,000 damage of the weak element.
::*Changes weaknesses 2 minutes after the [[File:Red.png||link=]] proc or after depleting a a certain amount of HP, whichever occurs first.

* Casts various AoE enfeebles, tier IV agas, AoE ancient magic
** <50% HP, also casts [[Comet]] and AoE [[Kaustra]] (high darkness damage and powerful DoT).
* Highly resistant to all types of elemental damage except [[light]]-, [[fire]]-, [[thunder]]-, and [[wind]]-based damage.
* Uses the following TP moves:
** '''Malign Invocation''': AoE damage/amnesia
** '''Tabbiyaa Gambit''': Heals Pil (~2200 HP) and removes debuffs
*** Tabbiyaa Gambit occasionally grants physical and magical damage immunity (more frequently as HP drops) which can only be removed by hitting any [[Voidwatch Weaknesses|weakness stagger]] or dealing 1000~2000 damage through the shield (the required amount varies).
**** This effect appears as a visible shield around Pil.
**** Pil's Magic Damage (including Flank Opening and Malign Invocation damage) is increased by 50% when the shield is up.
**** The shield will be randomly penetrable by one of the following types of damage:
***** Hand-to-hand
***** Non-hand-to-hand blunt (staff, club)
***** Slashing
***** Melee piercing
***** Ranged Attacks
***** Magical Damage
**** The damage from [[Twilight Scythe]] melee attacks, [[Quick Draw]] shots, and [[Requiescat]] will always penetrate the shield.
**** Recommended to 'save' easy triggers such as Job Abilities to remove this quickly.
**** This was renamed from Bishop's Gambit in the 3/27/12 Version Update.
** '''Shah Mat''': Pil gains a temporary Terror/Doom gaze
*** The gaze effect becomes active a few seconds after use allowing tanks sufficient time to turn.
** '''Flank Opening''': AoE high damage/knockback & Defense Down aura
* Pil has 113 INT, 98 MND, 90 CHR, -12.5% [[Magic Damage Taken]], and 50 [[Magic Defense Bonus]]

{{Adversary Description
|Image=
|Class=NM
|Type=
|Family=Poroggo
|Main.Job=Black Mage
|Sub.Job=
|Crystal=Water
|Detects=True Sound
|Notes= 
* Uses all [[:Category:Poroggo|Poroggo]] abilities.
* Can use ''Frog Chorus''.
** Large AoE [[Charm]] and frog transformation. 
* All her spells have a very high chance of being interrupted.
=Strategy=
* It is advised you keep [[DoT|DoT]] effects on the Madame when fighting it, in case it charms everyone in range. 
* [[DoT|DoT]] should not be used under 5% , just in case it dies unclaimed.
* Keep a maximum of 2 - 3 melee on her, as feeding her [[TP]] is very counterproductive.
* Mages should attempt to stay out of the 20' unit range from her to avoid ''Frog Chorus''. 
* [[Haste|Hasted]] [[Stun|stunners]] are good for fighting her. A [[BLU]] with a lot of Haste that spams [[Head Butt]] tends to stun a large percentage of the TP moves and can counteract the negative effects of having too many melees on her.
* If she casts [[Graviga|Graviga]] after ''Providence'', do not [[Erase]] it, so if ''Frog Chorus'' occurs, all the [[Charm (Status)|Charmed]] melees will be moving slowly.
[[category:Bestiary]]
[[category:Beastmen]]
[[category:Poroggo]]}}

**Cannot be removed via [[Silena]] or [[Echo Drops]].
* '''Winds of Oblivion:''' AoE [[Amnesia]], lasts up to 75 seconds.
* '''Meteor (spell):''' AoE magic damage (300-600)
** He casts this once a minute.
* '''Bastion of Twilight:''' Magic Shield effect.
* '''Wheel of Impregnability:''' [[Invincible]].
*You can tell which shield is up by looking at the ring below [[Promathia]]. 
**Red is physical, green is magic.

{{Adversary Description |Image=Update05-15-2012 1.jpg |Class= VWNM |Type=Unclassified |Family=Supreme Being |Main.Job= |Sub.Job= |Crystal= |Detects= |Notes=*First defeated as part of the quest [[Crystal Guardian]], but may be repeated indefinitely. *The fight takes place in a battlefield which has a time limit of 30 minutes. ** Entry into the battlefield requires key items [[Beguiling petrifact]], [[Maddening petrifact]], and [[Seductive petrifact]] from each player -- all three will be lost upon entry. *Items may be obtained via individual glimmering troves and a general treasure pool from Provenance Watcher. The treasure pool will include 1 or 2 pieces of Provenance Watcher equipment and 0 or 1 of the two possible scrolls. *Has around 350,000 HP (HP bar is not visible, but can be estimated based on the current stance). *As HP decreases, advances through three stances which alter the potential set of TP moves and magic spells: ** Stance 1: Wings closed ** Stance 2: Two wings open (~75% HP) ** Stance 3: Four wings open (~50% HP) *Upon shifting to stance 3, Provenance Watcher will reset its aura to choose a new list of potential weakness triggers (a message will be displayed in the battle log when this occurs). *Physical attacks vary in power and additional effect depending on the relative location of the target (front: [[Stun]], side: {{question}}, or rear: [[Paralyze]]). *Uses Draw-In if hate target is out of range during a TP move or spell cast. *Casts the following spells (increasing in tier as HP decreases): ** AoE debuffs ([[Addle]], [[Stun]], [[Silencega]], [[Paralyga]], [[Blindga]], [[Breakga]], [[Diaga III]]) ** Stance 1: Tier III single target nukes, ** Stance 2: Tier IV single target and tier III -ga nukes, [[Holy]], [[Comet]] ** Stance 3: Tier V single target and tier IV -ga nukes, [[Holy II]], [[Meteor]] ** <25% HP: Replaces tier IV -ga nukes with tier V -ga nukes. *Can be stunned but builds resistance (spells should be stunned whenever possible to avoid Crystal Fetters). *Uses the following TP moves: ** '''Prismatic Breath''': AoE (conal) damage & [[Inhibit TP]] ([[Store TP]] reduction) ** '''Acicular Brand''': AoE damage (other effects? This code and information has been copied verbatim from the [http://wiki.bluegartr.com BlueGartr Wiki].
** Stance 3: '''Phason Beam''': AoE damage & [[Magic Defense Down]] ** Stance 3: '''Crystal Bolide''': AoE damage, [[Terror]], & [[Obliviscence]] (disables sub jobs) ** Stance 3: '''Fragor Maximus''': AoE damage {{verification}} and [[weakness]], Provenance Watcher gains strong "Killer" (intimidation) effect for some time. * May summon one [[Crystal Fetter]] (up to three may be out simultaneously) upon successful casting of any spell. ** The chance of a Crystal Fetter spawning increases with each stance (nearly guaranteed in the third stance). ** Damage taken by Provenance Watcher is drastically cut until these are defeated (cut by ~99% with three present, ~80% with two present, and ~50% with one present) ** The Crystal Fetters are each associated with one of the eight elements represented by their color and the element of Fetter will match that of the spell that spawned it. ** Each Crystal Fetter has approximately 5000 HP. ** Crystal Fetters are stationary and do not attack. ** Each Crystal Fetter has a debuffing aura of two statuses associated with its element (the debuff effects wear off if the player moves out of range or the fetter is defeated): *** Darkness (red/purple glow): [[Bio]], 5-count [[Doom]] *** Light (white/light blue glow): [[Dia]], [[Curse (Recovery)]] *** Fire (red glow): [[Burn]], [[Attack Down]] {{verification}} *** Ice (light blue glow): [[Frost]], [[Magic Attack Down]] {{verification}} *** Wind (green glow): [[Choke]], [[Evasion Down]]

|Detects= 
|Notes= 
*Higher level version of [[Kirin]]
*Does not use [[Astral Flow]]
*Immune to [[Stun]]
*Has a strong auto-regen effect
*Casts earth-based magic including [[Stone V]], '''Stonega IV''', [[Stoneja]], [[Slowga]], [[Breakga]], and AoE [[Quake]] as well as [[Sleepga]]
*Uses the following TP moves (all are single target except Heat Breath):
** '''Heat Breath''' (1000 fire damage, cannot be blocked by Fanatic's Drink or Fool's Drink, but can be partially resisted)
** '''Great Sandstorm''' (Earth damage & [[Blind]])
** '''Great Whirlwind''' (Wind damage & [[Choke]])
** '''Tail Smash''' (Physical damage, absorbed by shadows)
** '''Tail Swing''' (Physical damage & [[Bind]], absorbed by shadows)
** '''Deadly Hold''' (Very high physical damage, absorbed by shadows)
*Can summon alternate versions of the lesser sky gods one at a time, like Kirin. The summoning order is random, and more than one (up to all four) can be out at a time if they are not killed. The first is summoned approximately 2-5 minutes into the fight, with additional summoned every 2-3 minutes thereafter. They will not use 2-hour abilities, and once killed they will not be re-summoned, but they do use all of their counterparts' TP moves as well as cast higher tier versions of the spells associated with their element.
** '''Xuan Wu''' (Genbu) occasionally has a [[Poison]] aura, casts water-based spells (AoE [[Flood]], [[Water V]], [[Waterja]], '''Waterga IV''', '''Poisonga II''')
** '''Bai Hu''' (Byakko) occasionally has a [[Flash]] aura and high evasion, casts light-based spells ([[Holy]], [[Banish IV]], '''Banishga IV''', '''Diaga III''')
** '''Qing Long''' (Seiryu) occasionally has a [[Silence]] aura, casts wind-based spells (AoE [[Tornado]], [[Aero V]], [[Aeroja]], '''Aeroga IV''')
** '''Zhu Que''' (Suzaku) occasionally has a [[Paralyze]] aura and amnesia additional effect on melee attacks, casts fire-based spells (AoE [[Flare]], [[Fire V]], [[Firaja]], '''Firaga IV''')
** The summoned helpers have a significant amount of HP and are just as strong as Qilin, so it is typically easier to continue fighting Qilin and have someone pull and hold the summons away from the group as they are spawned.}}

**[[Trusts]] will not trigger.
**Pet damage to include abilites, skillchains and magic bursts will not trigger.

**[[Enspell]] and Rune Enchantment will not trigger.
*Uses Chthonian Ray which inflicts [[Doom]] on multiple targets in a long conal area.

*The safest method to defeat Revetaur is to rely solely on auto-attack damage, debuffs that do not cause damage in log, pets and trusts.

* Can not spawn if one of the following mobs have spawned: [[Huginn]], [[Muninn]], [[Heithrun]].

In Norse mythology, Sæhrímnir was the cosmic boar killed and eaten every night by the Æsir and [[Einherjar|einherjar]]. The cook of the gods, Andhrímnir, was responsible for the slaughter and preparation using the cauldron named Eldhrímnir. After Sæhrímnir was eaten, he was brought back to life to provide sustenance for the following day.

====Getting There====
*The [[Engraved Tablet]] to reach the islet with [[Silver Sea salt]] is located in [[Mount Zhayolm]] at I-10
**Use the [[Voidwatch]] warp to [[Mount Zhayolm]]. Take the tunnel to your left, and proceed to the most southern coast of the map.

====The Fight====
* Can use [[Draw In]].
* Casts [[Burn]], [[Blaze Spikes]], [[Fire IV]], [[Firaga II]], [[Firaga III]], [[Flare II]].
* Has Additional effect: Poison on melee hits.
* Gains a [[Regen]] effect when [[Blaze Spikes]] is active.
* Uses [[Chainspell]] at 89%, 69%, 49%, 29% and 9%.
** When active, will chain spells as well as TP moves (including Gates of Hades when under 25% HP).
* Will howl at random times throughout the fight.
** The following sequence of actions will occur after a howl: Ululation - [[Firaga III]] - Magma Hoplon - Howl (ends sequence)
*** Starting at 25% HP, Gates of Hades will replace [[Firaga III]] in the sequence.
* Has a 60 minute rage timer.

This leaves the fight timer at ~23:00 minutes. ** Aside from a special second Mantri (see below), only one of each add can be alive at a time. ** Schah gains a considerable DT-% while '''two''' or more of his adds are alive. Degree of the DT-% depends on the number of adds alive. *'''Bhata''' x7 (Pawn) **[[Sippoy]] variant. **Initially spawns 30 seconds into the fight. Subsequent spawns are 48 seconds after the previous death. **Casts [[Fire VI]], Firaga IV, and [[Firaja]]. **Unique ability: '''Dark Arrivisme''' - AoE Knockback and dispels 3 enhancements. **Weakest of all the adds. **If a Bhata is left alive for over 2 minutes, it may transform into a second Mantri. A new Bhata will spawn soon after. A Bhata cannot transform if a transformed Mantri is already present. *'''Ashva''' x2 (Knight) **[[Kutharei]] variant. **Initially spawns 60 seconds into the fight, then again 48 seconds after the first death. **Casts [[Aero VI]], Aeroga IV, [[Aeroja]], and Silencega. **Unique ability: '''Banneret Charge''' - 20' AoE, sets HP to 1 and resets hate. *'''Gaja''' x2 (Bishop) **[[Yaanei]] variant. **Initially spawns 90 seconds into the fight, then again 78 seconds after the first death. **Casts [[Stone VI]], Stonega IV, [[Stoneja]], and Slowga. **'Unique ability': '''Besieger's Bane''' - AoE Bio, Zombie, and Terror. **Weaker than other adds (excluding Bhata), however '''Stygian Sphere''' will provide Gaja with a special damage shield. ***Significantly reduces physical damage dealt and magical damage will do 0 damage. ****Continuing to hit with magical damage will remove the shield. Dealing physical damage will not remove it. ****Special damage abilities such as [[Requiescat]] and [[Quick Draw]] will not remove the shield, but will bypass it. *'''Ratha''' x2 (Rook) **[[Iratham]] variant. **Initially spawns 120 seconds into the fight, then again 78 seconds after the first death. **Casts [[Water VI]], [[Blizzard VI]], Waterga IV, Blizzaga IV, [[Waterja]], [[Blizzaja]], Bindga, and Paralyga. **Unique ability: '''Shadow Wreck''' - AoE damage and 50% Defense Down. May give Ratha a powerful [[Dread Spikes]]-like buff after if this move goes off. *'''Mantri''' (Queen) **[[Rani]] variant. **Spawns 180 seconds into the fight. This Mantri will not respawn if killed. **Casts [[Thunder VI]], Thundaga IV, [[Thundaja]], [[Stun]] (AoE), and Sleepga. **Unique ability '''Enthrall''' - AoE Charm and costume party, used at ≤50% **Relatively resistant to magic damage, taking approximately 50% of the magic damage that a bhata takes. **A second, separate Mantri may spawn from a Bhata that is left alive for too long. This Mantri appears to be identical to the first and both may be alive at the same time. Due to the relative strength of a Mantri, it is strongly recommended to prevent any Bhata from transforming. **Because at least two of Schah's adds may be alive without granting him the effect of reduced damage taken, you may mantri alive if all other adds are slain assuming your group can sustain holding her. *'''Schah''' **[[Raja]] variant. **Casts every spell used by its adds. **Possesses high regain and all abilities from its adds, including '''Banneret Charge''' and '''Enthrall'''. **Unique ability: '''Royal Decree''' - AoE damage and resets all ability timers. ***Unlike Raja's Royal Decree, this does not set player's subjobs to level 0. ****Square Enix probably would have made it do this, but they can't place SJ Restriction on a player while a level restriction effect is already in place. (You have one every time you pop a Geas Fete NM.) *Time will likely be your largest concern in this fight due to the number of foes. *Similar to most Geas Fete NM's (barring [[Warder of Courage]]) Schah's adds spawn with hate on the person who first had hate on Schah; this is always the popper unless he has since gone passive. Schah himself at high HP is not particularly threatening, and can be held alone away from the group while another tank (the popper) deals with the adds exclusively. **This includes using the abilities [[Provoke]], [[Flash]], etc. ***Using self target spells and abilities including [[Reprisal]] will not cause any problems. *Adds are very resistant to sleep, but not immune. }} ==Listings== {{Adversary Table 2 |Adversary Row 2= {{Adversary Row 2 |Class=escha |Zone=Reisenjima |Title=Schah Scraper |Crystal= |Treasure= * {{ItemIcon|Takoba|22}} {{tooltip|text=[[Takoba]]|tooltip=[[File:Takoba description.png]]}} * {{ItemIcon|Oranyan|22}} {{tooltip|text=[[Oranyan]]|tooltip=[[File:Oranyan description.png]]}} * {{ItemIcon|Nzingha Cuirass|22}} {{tooltip|text=[[Nzingha Cuirass]]|tooltip=[[File:Nzingha Cuirass description.png]]}} * {{ItemIcon|Ahosi Leggings|22}} {{tooltip|text=[[Ahosi Leggings]]|tooltip=[[File:Ahosi Leggings description.png]]}} *Luck+ [[Vorseal]] {{KI}} |Steal= |Despoil= |Battlefield Name= |Spawn Type=forced |Spawn Condition=Examine ??? with a [[Schah's gambit]]. :All members require [[Tribulens]] or [[Radialens]]. |Abilities= |Spells= |Traits= |Level= 150 |Aggro=n |Link=y |Detects= |HP= |MP=y |Defense= |Evasion=[http://www.ffxiah.com/forum/topic/48251/reisenjima-t4s/13/#3234560 1586] |Magic Defense= |Assisted By='''Schah's Bhata''' x7

Gaja gain a magic shield, -99% PDT, and MAB boost. Magic damage removes the shield. |Abilities.Condition=Gaja, Mantri, Schah }} {{Bestiary Abilities Row |Abilities.Name= Stygian Cyclone |Abilities.Yalms=15' |Abilities.Area=AoE |Abilities.Target= |Abilities.Class=magical |Abilities.Type=dark |Abilities.Effect= Damage and Silence effect |Abilities.Condition='''All''' }} }} ==Backstory== Shah or "Schah" is the Persian (Iranian) word for King, Asvha is Sanskrit (Indian) for horse, Gaja is Sanskrit for elephant, Ratha is Sanskrit for chariot, Mantri is Sanskrit for minister or sage, and Bhata is Sanskrit for infantry, soldier, servant, slave, etc. This NM is based off of the 6th century (CE) Indian strategy game of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chaturanga Chaturanga] or modern day chess. The king, minister, chariots, elephants, horses, and infantry were set up according to battle formations described in ancient literature and poetry. In the game though while the rest of the pieces are the same, Schah is not one of them. The king is named Raja, but since both [[Raja]] and [[Shah]] were already used for caturae NMs SE likely named it this way because "Egh, close enough." How one takes chess pieces and translates them to caturae behavior is also anyones guess.

wikitext.Serpopard Ishtar:
{{Adversary Description |Image= |Class=NM |Type= |Family=Dhalmel |Main.Job=Warrior |Sub.Job= |Crystal=Earth |Detects=Sight |Notes= * Placeholder IDs and locations: ** North: (G-5),(H-5),(H-6) — EE hex (238) is the 1st of a group of 4 dhalmels ** South: (H-8) - (I-8) — 70 hex (112) is the 1st of a group of 3 dhalmels ** {{Icon|Verification}}Northwest: (G-4) - (G-5) — 17E hex (382) is the 1st of a group of 3 dhalmels **{{Icon|Verification}} PHs seem to have ~7 minute respawn time. * NM IDs are 73 hex (115) and F2 hex (242). * Each PH can spawn '''Serpopard Ishtar''', however only one can spawn at once. * Window reopens almost immediately after a PH kill. * Respawn timers (for both North and South variations) are separate. *'''[[Trial of the Magians]]''': Required objective for the following trials: **[[file:Side-sword icon.png|20px|link=Trial_of_the_Magians_Swords#Empyrean_Trials]][[Trial 150]] - 3 kills * See the Discussion page for further helpful details. ==History/Background== A Serpopard is a mythical creature of Egyptian origin. He is featured mostly on decorated cosmetic palettes from the pre-dynastic era. wikitext.Shadow Lord (S):
{{Adversary Description
|Image=
|Class=NM
|Type=Demon
|Family= Shadow Lord
|Main.Job= Dark Knight
|Sub.Job= Black Mage
|Crystal=Dark
|Detects=Sight
|Notes= 
*'''Blighting Blitz''': Deals high physical damage.
**Only used with 2 Swords
**Absorbed by 2 Shadows 
*'''Soma Wall''': Absorbs physical damage and restores HP equivalent to the damage taken. 
**This ability lasts 30 ~ 45 seconds and melees should disengage/face away while it is in effect. 
**Duration of the ability can be seen with the orbs in his armor. Normally they are purple but during this ability, they will glow red. Once they return to purple, continue your attack.
*'''Spell Wall''': Absorbs magical damage and restores HP equivalent to damage taken. This ability lasts 30 ~ 45 seconds and magical damage should be avoided while in effect.
*'''Cross Smash''': Cone damage with additional effect [[Defense Down]].
*'''Vicious Kick''': Single target damage with additional effect [[Paralyze]].
*'''Doom Arc''': Does 300~700 damage with extreme knock-back effect after a short dialogue and inflicts a 10 second Doom.
*'''Implosion''': inflicts Max HP Down and does 200~500 damage to party members within the area of effect. 
* Has the ability to summon 4 clones. Followed by a quick dialogue and an Utsusemi-like animation. 
**Clones have low HP and defense, but high attack power. 
* Certain weapon skills also have a [[Dispel]] effect.
* While switching from 1 sword to 2 and vice versa, he becomes invincible for about 10 seconds. 
* Hate deteriorates rapidly during the fight and is reset each time he swaps weapon modes.
* Highly resistant to magic damage.
* Melee damage is slightly resisted.
}}

*Only TP move used is '''Exponential Burst''' - AoE damage and [[Magic Defense Down]].
*Casts ancient magic, tier 4 -ga spells, and AoE enfeebles with some amount of [[Fast Cast]] and occasional instant cast.
*At 50% HP, uses [[Manafont]] and casts either [[Burst]] or '''Thundaga IV''' repeatedly in succession.
*Spawns [[Meeble Scribe]]s and [[Meeble Augur]] to assist throughout the fight. These are summoned one at a time, every time a spell is successfully casted (a stunned spell will not spawn an add). 
**Up to five assisting meebles can be present at once.
**Only one [[Meeble Augur]] will be initially summoned, and there is no limit to the amount of [[Meeble Scribe]]s that can be summoned if they are defeated.
***A second [[Meeble Augur]] can be summoned if the fight is sufficiently long (>10 minutes).
**They are all sleepable and have relatively low HP. 
**Note that these meebles can drop [[Meeble Claw]] and are currently the only monsters that can do so (Meeble Augur has the highest drop rate).

*Uses one of three [[File:Two-Hour.png|link=]] ([[Invincible]] [[Soul Voice]] or [[Manafont]]) at 79%, 59%, 39%, 29%, 19% and 9%.
:*When it falls to 9% it will keep using these Special Ability constantly.

*Each Special Ability is accompanied by a behavior change and an aura effect with a considerable range exceeding 25-30 yalms.
**[[File:Two-Hour.png|link=]] '''[[Invincible]]''' - ~300/tick [[Dia]] aura for 30 seconds.
***Casts [[Protect V]], [[Shell V]], Banish IV, [[Cure VI]].
**[[File:Two-Hour.png|link=]] '''[[Soul Voice]]''' - [[Mute]] aura for 60 seconds.
***Casts [[Wind Threnody II]], [[Magic Finale]], [[Pining Nocturne]], [[Massacre Elegy]], [[Maiden's Virelai]].
***Gains access to '''Entice''' - Single target Charm.
****[[Geo-Vex]] and [[Geo-Attunement]] can often prevent this charm from landing.
*****However, only a [[Charm Buffer]] will reliably stop [[Maiden's Virelai]]
******Charm Buffer may also be dispeled via Finale or Sonic Buffet.
**[[File:Two-Hour.png|link=]] '''[[Manafont]]''' - Magic Defense Down aura for 60 seconds.
***Casts [[Aero VI]], [[Aeroja]], Aeroga V, [[Impact]], [[Death]].
*At the conclusion of each [[File:Two-Hour.png|link=]]'s duration, Teles will display another SP animation indicating she has returned to her prior AI.
*Inflicting {{ice}} ice or {{dark}} darkness damage or status ailments right as the opening [[File:Two-Hour.png|link=]] SP animation goes off has a chance to proc Teles.
:*[[File:Red.png|link=]] forces her to shift her chosen SP to a different one, and [[File:White!!.png|link=]] terminates the SP.
::*The auras accompanying the SP's will shift and terminate accordingly, and the closing SP animation will also display if one is successfully terminated.

*Resets [[Enmity]] on its current target when heavy damage is dealt to it from a distance.
**If attempting a magic burst setup, a second tank is recommended.
**Favors using '''Clarsach Call''' when this hate reset occurs. 
***This move deals high AoE {{wind}} magic damage exceeding 25'-30' and applies many physical and magical offensive and defensive enhancements to Teles. 
****It is recommended to have several members dispel these buffs.
****[[Distract III]] will overwrite and prevent the evasion boost from Clarsach Call.
}}

==Backstory==
[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Siren_(mythology) Teles] is one of the various Siren Sisters in Greek mythology. No one can seem to agree on the number of them or names. Homer didn't even give them names in fact.

However, Sirens seek to who lure unsuspecting victims with their enchanting music and voices and shipwreck on the rocky coast of their island. Comparatively in FFXI [[:Category:Siren|Sirens]] are dangerous creatures which wish to "entice" and charm you. Causing you to assist in the murder all your companions in the hopes of keeping you from obtaining an [[Aeonic Weapon]].

*The [[Engraved Tablet]] to reach the islet with [[Sicklemoon salt]] is located in [[Wajaom Woodlands]] at H-13
**A quick way to reach the [[Engraved Tablet]] is to take the Unity warp (level 135 to [[Wajaom Woodlands]]).
====The Fight====
*Spawns at 50% HP with one of its three heads up. 
**After two minutes and thirty seconds has passed since spawning, it re-grows a head and gains 25% HP.
**After another two minutes and thirty seconds has passed again, it will cause Tinnin to regrow its final head and regain another 25% HP and the auto-regen will vanish.
**Impossible to defeat until both heads have respawned.
*Every time Pyric Bulwark (physical shield) or Polar Bulwark (magic shield) is used, Nerve Gas will be used immediately after.
** Nerve Gas gives a powerful [[Poison]] effect and [[Curse]]. [[Holy Water]]s recommended.
*Weak regen even with all three heads intact.
*It is possible to land full strength [[Elemental Magic]] and all standard [[Enfeebling Magic]], [[Carnage Elegy]], etc.
*Can use [[Mighty Strikes]] once.

*Assisted by two '''Bloodswiller Flies'''.

* Normal hits are frontal AoE and take multiple shadow images.
** Will continue normal attack rounds even if the current hate target is out of range.
** Occasionally jumps and lands for high radial AoE damage in place of a normal attack round.
* Uses the following TP moves:
** '''Slicing Sickle''': Frontal AoE heavy physical damage, knockback, and defense down
** '''Macerating Bile''': AoE heavy DoT Bio and all stats down
** '''Raptorial Claw''': Frontal AoE physical damage, knockback, and magic defense down

*** Each of the buffs are dispellable, but it will take four dispels to remove them all.
** '''Phlegm Expulsion''': AoE Slow, Silence, Amnesia
** '''Exorender''': Unique TP move, frontal AoE damage, kills any Bloodswiller Flies in AoE (this will cause it to level up in the same manner as if a player killed them).

|Notes=
* Wanted objective unlocks upon [[Sarama]], [[Shedu]], and [[Thu'ban]] [[Unity|Wanted objective]] clears.
* Time limit of 30 minutes.
*When spawning and despawning, Tumult Curator will attack the player who started the fight.
*Adds named "''Tumult Curator''" need to be defeated to progress to the next stage while ones named "''Tumult Lamp''" do not.
:*This makes targeting a specific monster slightly difficult.
*The Resistance (SDT) values to the right are that of [[Pandemonium Warden]] and other Dvergr NMs, and are thus assumed.
'''<big>Phase I</big>''': Four Chariots (Level 119)
*Spawns [[Armored Chariot]], [[Battleclad Chariot]], [[Long-Armed Chariot]], [[Long-Bowed Chariot]], and [[Archaic Gear]]s x6
**''Recommended order'': [[Long-Armed Chariot]], and then any others.
*Each respective Tumult Curator chariot will do their special [[Salvage]] moves, including: 
**'''Brainjack''' - Single target charm
**'''Discoid''' - High AoE damage split between party
**'''Homing Missile''' - AoE damage, inflicts 90% of party members HP
**'''Mortal Revolution'''  - AoE stun
'''<big>Phase II</big>''': ToAU Beastmen Kings (Level 125)
*Spawns [[Gulool Ja Ja]], [[Gurfurlur the Menacing]], and [[Medusa]] 6 Lamps in the form of Beastmen.
**''Recommended order'': Gurfurlur, Gulool, Medusa.
*Each King may use all of their special moves, most notably:
**'''Gurfurlur''' ([[Troll]])
***'''Pleiades Ray''' - (~10') Damage and Paralyze, Blind, Bind, Poison, Plague, Silence, Slow, and Stun.
**'''Medusa''' ([[Lamiae]])
***'''Pinning Shot''' - AoE damage and bind.
****Favors using this move.
**'''Gulool Ja Ja''' ([[Mamool Ja]])
***'''[[Mijin Gakure]]''' - Used at about >5%.
****This move may be mitigated via magic damage reduction or by simply defeating the monster quickly.
'''<big>Phase III</big>''':  [[Thu'ban]], [[Sarama]], [[Shedu]] (Level 135)
*Spawns [[Thu'ban]] (Hydra), [[Sarama]], [[Shedu]], 6 Lamps in the form of: 2 Dahaks, 2 Puks & 2 Bombs.
**''Recommended order'': Hydra, Khimaira, Cerberus.
*Hydra starts with the left and right head missing and at 50% HP. It cannot be killed until both heads generate at least once, causing it to regenerate 25% each time.
*The Hydra, Khimaira, Cerberus may be [[File:Blue.png|link=]] proced under unknown conditions causing them to becomed terrorized temporarily. 
**These seem to be the same mechanics as the UNM fights.
'''<big>Phase IV</big>''': Dvergr (Level 145)
*Spawns Tumult Lamps x6.
**Lamps are susceptible to being slept with a [[Lullaby]].
***Depending on the equipment and Master Level of the BRD, they may need to use [[Troubadour]].
*Gains high percentage Intimidation effect that lasts one minute upon spawning. Secondary reason to cast Lullaby on Tumult Lamps.
*Uses [[Astral Flow]] at 74%, 49%, 24%, and 4%.
**If the popper of the fight has hate prior to [[Astral Flow]], they may disband to prevent the party from being hit by it.
***This player will maintain claim over Tumult Curator so a single damage dealer may need to also disband and join to push the HP past the % threshold, depending on the timing.
**Each avatar will target a random player. One player can be assigned multiple avatars. Spreading your group out can cause the Astral Flows to not overlap. This allows your group to have a greater chance of survival if individual members are capable of surviving multiple astral flows (2~3).
*Casts Aspir, Drain, Blindga, Dispelga, Dread Spikes, Impact, Meteor, Sleepga II, Tier V -ga spells, Tier VI Single nukes
**Meteor is gained under 50%.
*Gains a temporary 300/tic Bio aura (30') following '''Bilgestorm'''.
*Almost completely resistant to [[Finale]] and [[Elegy]] without [[Troubadour]] or [[Elemental Seal]].
**A "Complete Resist" message was not received, but neither ever landed without the Job Abilities active.
*Debuff Geomancy bubbles have a reduced effect.
}}

|Notes=
====Getting There====
*Requires a [[Cyan Deep salt]] Key Item from [[Sanraku]] for anyone wishing to go to the island Tyger is fought on.
* The level 135 Unity warp to [[Caedarva Mire]] places you on Hediva Isle close to the [[Engraved Tablet]] on the border of H-6/I-6.
* Alternatively, take the [[Nyzul Isle Staging Point]] and then the teleporter at H-8.
**Then the east (dim) teleporter and proceed forward to the zone to [[Caedarva Mire]].
*The zone is full of True Sight [[Imp]]s and [[Soulflayer]]s so you'll want to use a mount.
**Proceed off the map at the north east corner of I-7 to the [[Engraved Tablet]] at I-6 left of the words "Hediva Isle" on your map.
====The Fight====
*Uses the following:
**Fulmination - below 50% health. (30' range, Strong Paralyze)
** Fossilizing Breath Breath - Cone Attack Petrify.
**Tenebrous Mist - AoE TP reset.
**[[Tourbillion]] - AoE damage, Knockback, and Defense Down. Can be absorbed by 3 shadows.

==Where Urd can be found.==
*Rolanberry Fields (F,G-9,10,11,12), (I-9) 
*Rolanberry Fields (S) (G,F-11,12), (G-9), (K-10)
*Batallia Downs (E,F-5). (J,K-9)
*Batallia Downs (S) (H,I-7,8), (I-10)
*Sauromugue Champaign (G,H-7), (I-6)
*Sauromugue Champaign (S) (J,K-7) (F-6)

Found in field just outside Crawler's nest. Use survival guide.

==Ability Information==
*Casts Protect IV, Shell IV, Stoneskin, Cure IV, and Regen.
*Trance activates at 79%, 59% and 39% and can be used multiple times below 20%.
*When Trance activates, Urd immediately uses Zephyr Arrow > Lethe Arrows > Cyclonic Turmoil > Cyclonic Torrent in that order. 
*After it uses Cyclonic Torrent it resumes acting normally.
*Spring Breeze: AoE sleep and lowers TP by roughly 60%.
*Does not strip shadows.
*Cyclonic Torrent: AoE damage and Mute.
*Mute effect only last up to 45 seconds.
*This can be stunned.
*Winter Breeze: AoE Stun and Dispel.
*Cyclonic Turmoil: AoE Full Dispel and knockback.
*Easy to put Ichi up before animation is over.
*Tends to cast a spell right after this move, so very easy to put up shadows.
All AoE TP moves will damage everyone within range (even people passing by that have no hate).
Resistant to the effect of Flash, but not immune.
Easily dispelled by RDM Dispel and COR Dark Shot. Finale has a VERY HIGH resist rate but it can land.

* The first TP move Vir'ava will always use is '''Frond Fatale''' which inflicts a conal charm and spawns 7 '''Vir'ava's Rafflesia''' adds.
**The charm effect may be avoided via a [[Charm Buffer]], [[Fealty]], or significant magic evasion (including  {{light}} light resistance).
**The Rafflesia will spawn and go after the player that initially spawned Vir'ava.
**Five of the adds are normal Rafflesia while two are black Rafflesia which posses a strong poison aura.
***Adds are all susceptible to sleep and petrifaction.
***Adds will spam Bloody Caress and have a fair amount of HP (~30,000).
* If Rafflesia are near Vir'ava then it will use '''Full Bloom''', devouring the adds and leveling up.
** The next TP move will then be '''Frond Fatale'''.
*If even one ordinary Rafflesia is absorbed by Vir'ava it will then use '''Frond Fatale''' again.
*However, if the two black Rafflesia are brought next to Vir'ava then it will absorb them via '''Leeching Vines''' and proc [[File:Blue.png|link=]].
**This will not level up Vir'ava, and it will not use '''Frond Fatale''' unless an ordinary Rafflesia is defeated or absorbed.
**After the [[File:Blue.png|link=]] proc, the magical and physical evasion of Vir'ava will be lowered significantly. It may also assumedly become weaker in other ways. {{Information Needed}}
* Gains access to '''Beautiful Death''' < 50% which is an AoE Charm and 10 second doom.
**Players hit by this have no recourse except for death.
**This may be avoided via a [[Charm Buffer]], [[Fealty]], or significant magic evasion (including  {{light}} light resistance).
***Do not underestimate magic evasion gear macros to avoid this. [[Rune Fencer]]s should also be able to avoid it via three [[Tenebrae]] runes with a [[Pflug]].
***Players taking advantage of [[Geo-Vex]]/[[Indi-Attunement]] and/or magic evasion gear should be able to reliably avoid the charm and thus the doom from this move.
}}

* ''Exploitable Weakness'': The total physical and magical that is dealt between TP moves is compared and Volatile Matamata will take half damage from the higher dealt type and double damage from the lesser dealt type after the next TP move. This effect is cumulative, up to seven times. If the boosted type of damage becomes greater than the reduced damage during any individual cycle, damage resistances and weaknesses will reset after the next TP move.
** As an example, by utilizing exclusively physical damage between TP move cycles until melee hits are consistently 0, two monks with [[Formless Strikes]] can quickly defeat the NM from full HP (note that the NM is fairly evasive and Accuracy-boosting effects are recommended).
** Once one type of damage has reached 0 (and the other has reached 128x), resistance and weakness will automatically reset after the next TP move, regardless of whether the opposing damage type was dealt.
** TP moves utilized by Volatila Matamata are time-based (45-60 seconds between moves), not TP-based.

wikitext.Wopket: {{Disambiguation|Yumcax}} {{Adversary Description |Image= |Class= |Type=Plantoids |Family=Yggdreant |Main.Job= |Sub.Job= |Crystal= |Detects= |Notes= *Wopket is the [[earth]]-based, plantoid Delve boss of Yorcia Weald. Due to these attributes, he is vulnerable to wind damage, fire damage, and slashing damage. **He is significantly resistant to piercing damage. *Wopket's auto-attacks function as special moves and are chosen randomly from one of three types: **Branch Poke: Single-target darkness-based breath damage that drains HP **Branch Sweep: Conal physical damage and evasion down **Branch Spin: Frontal (180-degree) physical damage and stun effect *Wopket gains a visible aura of swarming fireflies after using '''Uproot'''. This aura inflicts a potent Dia effect on those in range and grants Wopket a fairly potent Regen effect. *'''Uproot''' is guaranteed to be used once as the next TP move when Wopket drops below a random HP threshold ranging from 25% to ~95%. As a result, you will always see '''Uproot''' used at least once each fight, but possibly not used multiple times. Random uses aside from this guaranteed use are rare but do happen. This chance increases when Wopket drops below 25% HP. *Wopket's spells and abilities are modified by whether or not the aura from Uproot is in effect. The heuristic changes are as follows: **Wopket will use his highest-tier available spells while the aura is in effect, favoring area of effect spells over single target spells. **Wopket's TP moves will assume a fixed sequence that includes '''Tiiimbeeer''' (doom) after the aura is activated. ***After activation of the aura from an initial use of '''Uproot''', '''Uproot''' will always be used once more as the next TP move, TP permitting. The next permitting TP move following the second consecutive '''Uproot''' may be '''Tiiimbeeer''' if the aura is still active. ***This sequence repeats indefinitely after '''Tiiimbeeer''' is used if the aura remains active. Thus, you will see at least two uses of '''Uproot''' followed by another '''Tiiimbeeer'''. You will never see '''Tiiimbeeer''' used twice consecutively. **The aura has a chance of being removed each time ''any form'' of [[wind]]-based damage is dealt. For each amount of wind damage taken, Wopket's aura has a chance to break with the chance significantly increasing as the amount of damage increases. ***5000 Points of damage has approximately an 80% chance of breaking the aura. Anything over 7000 will almost always (~95% chance) break the aura. The exact amounts needed possibly vary with the number of people brought in. ***Because the amounts of damage needed to reliably drop the aura are high, Blood Pacts and Skillchains with the wind attribute (Light, Fragmentation, and Detonation chains) are strongly favored for this purpose. *In general, Wopket favors Firefly Fandango (Flash, Paralyze, Max MP Down) most and secondarily favors Canopierce (distributed damage and rasp) and Potted Plant (low damage, blind and Slow). *'''Tiiimbeeer''' is ''never'' used as a random TP move. It is only used as the next permitting TP move following ''at least two'' consecutive uses of '''Uproot''' and ''only if the aura is active''. *Wopket can be paralyzed and slept with enough magic accuracy. *Wopket is susceptible, but extremely resistant to slow. *Despite being earth-based, Wopket does ''NOT'' appear to have access to Break or Breakga. }} ==Listings== {{Adversary Table |Notes= *Uses [[Eagle Eye Shot]] multiple times.
*Summons multiple '''Goblin Mines''' that detonate with Mine Blast.
**At 80%, summons 1 mine.
**At 60%, summons 2 mines.
**At 40%, summons 4 mines.
**At 20%, summons 6 mines.
**At 10%, summons 8 mines.
** All mines are centered around the current hate target when they are summoned.
*** Mines spawn too far apart to -ga them all in one nuke
** Mine blast radius is exactly 29.9 yalms.
*** Mine damage chains together. If you are close enough to get hit by only one mine, but another is close to that one, you will get hit by damage of two.
** Mines have approximately 3,000 HP.
** Detonation timing seems to be 5-10 seconds after spawning.
** If you pull him to the edge of the arena, back line jobs can easily run to avoid spawned mines.
*** Do not fight him in the middle, because mines will spread far enough apart to hit everybody. 
*** If you fight him on the edge of the arena, front line players with significant amount of movement speed enhancement can barely get away. It does not always work, depending on mine spawn locations.
** Mines inflict exactly 1,500 damage each, and all detonate at the same time
*** as of 8/27/2021 1 mine did 5500 dmg. not sure how this was originally calculated
*** [[Scherzo]] does help negate damage, but due to lag players are not always hit with only one round of mines. It is not good to rely on it to survive.
*** Mine damage is fixed, like 1,000 needles, and is reduced by PDT.

|Notes=
*Posses a Regain effect.
**This seems to increase greatly while idle or when a target on top of the enmity list is out of range (kiting). 
* One of Yakshi's single target attacking animations has Additional effect: Drain, which always drains the same amount of HP as it swings for.
* Has access to the following abilities:
** '''[[Elemental Sforzo]]''' (30 seconds of magic immunity)
***May be used multiple times.
** '''Canopierce'''
***11,000 damage distributed 15' AoE {{earth}} Earth damage + [[Rasp]]. 
****The damage is unresistable and unaffected by [[Magic Defense Bonus]].
*****Other magic damage reductions such as [[Shell]], [[One for All]], [[Valiance]], etc are still effective.
******[[Aegis]]' MDT II is particualry effective for this reason.
** '''Root of the Problem'''
***Absorbs up to 1,000 TP and all buffs from the target.
** '''Potted Plant'''
***Inflicts low AoE damage, [[Slow]], and [[Bind]]
** '''Cordon of Apathy'''
***Inflicts moderate AoE damage a Dispel.
****Yakshi will gain a -50% HP curse aura, regen, increased magic resistance, and glow with a dark hue.
***** After gaining the Curse aura Yakshi will gain access to '''Tiiimbeeer'''.
*****Magic damage taken will go from -25% to -33% while the aura is up.
**'''Tiiimbeeer'''
***Low AoE damage plus Virus and a 10-count Doom. 
***May be used at any time after 50% with or without the Curse aura up.
****This doom will also affect Luopans.
***Since cursna may remove the curse aura instead of attempting to remove the doom itself. Players should also have [[Holy Water]]s to assist in removing the effect.
****Items such as the [[Purity Ring]] and [[Blenmot's Ring]] are helpful in increasing the removal rate of doom through [[Holy Water]]s.


*The aura is removed via {{light}} light damage. It may take many attempts to break the aura though.
** Light elemental magical Weapon Skills and skillchains may proc [[File:Blue.png|link=]] and seem to be the most effective.
***E.g. A [[Seraph Blade]] doing 0 damage while double weakened removed the aura after one use.
**Melee players will be often faced with stat down, virus, slowga, doomga, breakga, etc which will hamper skillchaining. 


*Vex and Attunement with a [[Bolster]]ed [[Idris]] does not stop the application of status ailments from various TP moves.

==Backstory==
Zerde is an Iraqi dessert. It is a sweet pudding from rice that is colored yellow with saffron and popularly served at weddings, birthdays, and other occasions.

Eating too many sweets is considered unhealthy though, but not as unhealthy for you as Zerde is. The only thing it will be forcing down your throat is sweet death as its bio aura (heart disease?) and custardy goons will put you into a sweet induced coma.
